verses.text: Abantu benshi baragerageje kwandika inkuru z’ivyabereye hagati muri twebwe,
nk’uko twazishikirijwe n’abavyiboneye kuva bigitangura, ari na bo bamamaje Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Ni co gituma nanje, maze gutohoza neza uko vyagenze vyose kuva mu ntango, nahisemwo kukwandikira inkuru y’ukuri kandi itomoye, nyakwubahwa Teyofilo,
kugira ngo umenye udakekeranya ko inyigisho wakiriye ari iz’ukuri.
Igihe Herode yari umwami w’i Yudaya, hari umuherezi yitwa Zakariya wo mu mugwi w’abaherezi bitirirwa Abiya. Umugore wiwe yitwa Elizabeti, na we akaba yakomoka mu muryango wa Aroni.
Zakariya na Elizabeti bari abagororotsi imbere y’Imana, kandi bakurikiza ivyagezwe n’amabwirizwa vy’Umwami Imana ata co bahajije.
Ariko nta mwana bari bafise, kuko Elizabeti atavyara, kandi bompi bari bashaje cane.
Umusi umwe, Zakariya yariko arakora igikorwa ciwe c’ubuherezi mu Ngoro y’Imana, kuko umugwi wiwe ari wo wari uramukiwe.
Yari yatowe hakoreshejwe ubupfindo nk’uko umugenzo w’ubuherezi wabitegekanya mu guhitamwo uwinjira mu rusengero rw’Umwami Imana guturira ibimota neza.
Igihe co guturira ivyo bimota neza kigeze, abari ngaho bose bariko basengera hanze.
Maze umumarayika w’Umwami Imana yiyereka Zakariya, ahagaze i buryo bw’igicaniro baturirirako ibimota neza.
Zakariya amubonye afatwa n’ubwoba bwinshi.
Ariko wa mumarayika aramubarira ati: “Zakariya we, ntutinye, kuko Imana yumvise ugusenga kwawe. Umugore wawe Elizabeti agiye kukuvyarira umwana w’umuhungu, na we uze umwite Yohana.
Uwo mwana azogutera kunezerwa no guhimbarwa, kandi ivuka ryiwe rizonezereza benshi,
kuko azoba uwuhambaye imbere y’Umwami Imana. Ntazokoza umuvinyu ku munwa canke ikindi kintu cose kiboreza, kandi azoba yuzuye Mpwemu Yera kuva akiri mu nda ya nyina.
Azogarukana Abisirayeli benshi k’Uhoraho, Imana yabo.

Azogendera imbere y’Umwami Imana afise impwemu n’ububasha nk’ivya Eliya, kugira ngo agarukane imitima y’abavyeyi ku bana babo, abatumvira Imana na bo abagarukane ku bwenge bw’abagororotsi; uko ni ko azotegurira abantu kwakira Umwami Imana.”
Zakariya abaza uwo mumarayika ati: “Ivyo novyemezwa n’iki, ko nshaje kandi umugore wanje akaba ageze mu zabukuru?”
Wa mumarayika aramwishura ati: “Ndi Gaburiyeli, kandi nama mpagaze imbere y’Imana. Ni yo yandungitse kukubwira iyi nkuru nziza.
Kuva ubu, ugiye kuba ikiragi, ntuzosubira kuvuga kugeza uwo mwana avutse, kuko utizeye ivyo ndakubwiye. Kandi bizoshika igihe cavyo kigeze.”
Mu gihe ivyo vyariko biraba, abantu bari hanze, bagumye barindiriye Zakariya bibaza igituma yatevye akamara mu rusengero umwanya munini.
Ariko asohotse, ntiyashobora kuvugana na bo. Abantu baca batahura ko hari ivyo yerekewe mu rusengero, kuko yabavugisha akoresheje ibimenyetso vy’amaboko, ntavuge.
Ikiringo c’ibikorwa vyiwe vy’ubuherezi kirangiye, asubira i muhira.
Haheze imisi, umugore wiwe Elizabeti asama inda, aca amara amezi atanu ataja ahabona. Avuga ati:
“Ehe ivyiza Umwami Imana yankoreye! Muri iki gihe, yangiriye ubuntu ankurako ibiteterwe mu bantu.”
Elizabeti amaze amezi atandatu yibungenze, Imana irungika umumarayika Gaburiyeli mu gisagara c’i Galilaya citwa Nazareti,
ku nkumi yitwa Mariya yari ikowe n’umusore yitwa Yosefu, wo mu muryango wa Dawidi.
Uwo mumarayika yinjira aho Mariya ari, amubwira ati: “Nezerwa! Umwami Imana akugiriye ubuntu, kandi ari kumwe na we.”
Mariya aterwa ubwoba bwinshi n’ayo majambo, yibaza ico iyo ndamukanyo isigura.
Ariko wa mumarayika aramuhumuriza ati: “Ntutinye, Mariya, kuko ugiriwe ubuntu n’Imana.
Raba ugiye gusama inda, maze uzovyara umwana w’umuhungu, kandi uze umwite Yesu.
Azoba uwuhambaye, kandi azokwitwa Umwana w’Iyisumbavyose. Umwami Imana azomuha intebe y’inganji ya sekuruza Dawidi,
kandi azoganza inzu ya Yakobo ibihe bidashira; Ubwami bwiwe ntibuzogira iherezo.”
Mariya abaza uwo mumarayika ati: “Ivyo vyoshoboka bite, ko ntarigera ndyamana n’umugabo?”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Mpwemu Yera azokuzako, maze ubushobozi bw’Iyisumbavyose bugutwikire. Ni co gituma umwana uzovyara azoba uwera, yitwe Umwana w’Imana.
Mbere na Elizabeti incuti yawe agiye kuvyara umwana mu myaka yiwe y’ubusaza. Uwahora yitwa ingumba, uku ni ukwezi kugira gatandatu yibungenze,
kuko ata jambo Imana ivuze ribura ububasha.”
Mariya aramwishura ati: “Jewe ndi umusavyikazi w’Umwami Imana, nibimbere nk’uko ubivuze.” Maze uwo mumarayika aca amusiga aho aragenda.
Muri iyo misi, Mariya aritegura, aduga yihuta aja mu misozi y’i Yudaya, mu gisagara,
Zakariya yabamwo. Ashitse, aramutsa umugore wiwe Elizabeti.
Na we yumvise indamukanyo ya Mariya, umwana yari mu nda yiwe ariginagura. Elizabeti aca yuzuzwa Mpwemu Yera,
avuga n’ijwi rirenga ati: “Urahezagiwe mu bandi bagore bose, n’umwana ari mu nda yawe arahezagiwe.
Mbega nari iki kugira ngo nyina w’Umwami wanje angendere?
Nabaye ncumva indamukanyo yawe, umwana ari mu nda aca ariginagura kubera umunezero.
Urahiriwe kuko wizeye ko ivyo Umwami Imana yavuze bizoshika.”
Mariya aravuga ati: “Umutima wanje urahimbaza Umwami Imana,
kandi impwemu yanje inezererewe Imana yo Mukiza wanje,
kuko yibutse umusavyikazi wayo muto. Uhereye ubu abantu bose bazonyita umuhirwe,
kuko Inyenkomezi yankoreye ibihambaye, izina ryayo ni iryera.
Igirira imbabazi abayubaha, uko uruganwe rukurikirana n’urundi.
Ukuboko kwayo kwakoze ivy’inkomezi; yashwiragije abishira hejuru mu mitima yabo.
Yakuye abatware ku ntebe z’inganji, ishira hejuru abaciye bugufi.
Yahagije ivyiza abashonje, yirukana abatunzi bagenda imbokoboko.
Yatabaye umusavyi wayo Isirayeli, yibuka kugirira imbabazi
Aburahamu n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe vyose, nk’uko yari yarabisezeraniye ba sogokuruza.”
Nuko Mariya amarana na Elizabeti amezi nk’atatu, araheza arataha.
Igihe ciwe co kwibaruka kigeze, Elizabeti yibaruka umwana w’umuhungu.
Incuti n’ababanyi bumvise ko Umwami Imana yamugiriye ubuntu, banezeranwa na we.
Umwana amaze imisi umunani, bamujana kumukeba. Bagira bamwite izina rya se Zakariya,
nyina arahakana, avuga ati: “Oya, izina ryiwe ni Yohana.”
Na bo baramubwira bati: “None ko ata n’umwe wo mu muryango wanyu yitwa iryo zina!”
Baca babaza se bakoresheje ibimenyetso ngo ababwire izina ashaka ko bita umwana wiwe.
Zakariya aca asaba ico kwandikako, yandika ati: “Izina ryiwe ni Yohana.” Bose baratangara.
Ubwo nyene akanwa kiwe gaca karuguruka, ururimi ruragoboroka, aca atangura kuvuga ahimbaza Imana.
Abari aho bose bafatwa n’ubwoba, kandi iyo nkuru yamamara mu misozi yose y’i Yudaya.
Abavyumva bose vyabatera kwibaza mu mitima bati: “None uwo mwana azoba umuntu ki?” Kuko vyaraboneka ko ubushobozi bw’Umwami Imana bwari kuri we.
Se Zakariya, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, atangura kuvugishwa ati:
“Amashimwe ni ay’Umwami, Imana ya Isirayeli, kuko yaje gutabara no gucungura abantu bayo.
Iduhagurukirije Umukiza ahambaye mu nzu ya Dawidi, umusavyi wayo
nk’uko yabisezeranye kera ikoresheje abavugishwa bayo bera,
izodukiza abansi bacu, iturokore no mu maboko y’abatwanka.
Yagiriye imbabazi ba sogokuruza, yibuka isezerano ryayo ryera,
ari yo ndahiro yarahiye sogokuruza Aburahamu;
ko izodukiza agahahazo k’abansi bacu, ikadushoboza kuyikorera ata bwoba,
mu kwera no mu kuyigororokera imisi yose yo kubaho kwacu.
Kandi nawe, mwana wanje, uzokwitwa uwuvugishwa n’Iyisumbavyose, kuko uzokwitangira imbere Umwami Imana, ukamutegurira inzira.
Uzokwigisha abantu biwe inzira y’agakiza kava mu guharirwa ivyaha vyabo.
Kubw’imbabazi nyinshi z’Imana yacu, umuco w’igitondo ugiye kuturasira uvuye mw’ijuru,
kugira ngo uboneshereze abari mu mwijima n’abari mu gitutu c’urupfu, wongere urongorere intambuko zacu mu nzira y’amahoro.”
Uwo mwana arakura, arakomera mu mpwemu, aba mu bugaragwa gushika igihe yiyerekeye Abisirayeli.
Muri iyo misi, Kayisari Ogusito, umwami w’abami w’Abaroma, asohora itegeko ko haba urusansuma rw’abantu bose baba mu bwami bw’Abaroma.
Urwo rwari urusansuma rwa mbere rubaye kandi ico gihe Kiriniyusi yatwara intara ya Siriya.
Nuko abantu bose baja mu bisagara bavukiyemwo kwisansumisha.
Yosefu na we nyene ava i Nazareti, igisagara c’i Galilaya, aduga i Yudaya mu gisagara ca Dawidi citwa Betelehemu, kuko yakomoka mu muryango wa Dawidi.
Nuko aja kwisansumisha ajanye na Mariya, uwo yari akoye, kandi Mariya yari yibungenze.
Bakiri i Betelehemu, igihe co kwibaruka kiragera,
maze avyara umwana wiwe w’imfura, amuzingira mu mpuzu z’uruyoya, aca amuryamika mu bwato inka ziriramwo, kuko bari babuze ikibanza mu nzu y’ingenzi.
Muri ako karere hari abungere bama barara mu gahinga baraririye imikuku y’ibitungwa vyabo.
Umumarayika w’Umwami Imana arabiyereka, ubwiza bw’Umwami Imana bubakayanganira impande zose, na bo baterwa n’ubwoba bwinshi cane.
Uwo mumarayika aca ababwira ati: “Ntimutinye kuko ndabazaniye inkuru nziza y’umunezero mwinshi ku bantu bose.
Uwu musi, umukiza yabavukiye mu gisagara ca Dawidi, ni we Kristo, Umwami.
Iki ni co kizobabera ikimenyetso: muzosanga uruyoya ruzingiriweko impuzu, ruryamitswe mu bwato inka ziriramwo.”
Ubwo nyene haca haboneka ingabo nyinshi cane zo mw’ijuru zifatanya n’uwo mumarayika, zihimbaza Imana ziti:
“Icubahiro kibe ic’Imana mw’ijuru riri hejuru y’ayandi, kw’isi na ho amahoro abe mu bantu bayihimbara.”
Abo bamarayika bamaze gusubira mw’ijuru, ba bungere baca baravugana bati: “Nimuze tugende i Betelehemu kuraba ivyabaye, ivyo Umwami Imana atubwiye.”
Baca bagenda bihuta, basangaho Mariya na Yosefu, n’umwana aryamye mu bwato inka ziriramwo.
Bamubonye baca babwira bose ivyo babwiwe kuri uwo mwana,
kandi abavyumva bose vyarabatangaza cane.
Ariko Mariya we, yaguma azigama ayo majambo yose mu mutima wiwe, akayiyumvirako cane.
Ba bungere na bo basubira inyuma bahimbaza Imana bongera bayitazira kubera ivyo bumvise n’ivyo babonye, kuko basanze bimeze nk’uko bari babibwiwe.
Ku musi ugira umunani, bahejeje gukeba uwo mwana, bamwita Yesu, nk’uko umumarayika yari yarabwiye Mariya imbere y’uko asama inda yiwe.
Igihe c’imigenzo yo guhumanurwa kigeze, nk’uko Ivyagezwe vya Mose vyabitegekanya, Yosefu na Mariya badugana Yesu i Yerusalemu kumushikanira Umwami Imana.
Nk’uko vyanditswe mu Vyagezwe vy’Uhoraho, “Umuhungu wese w’imfura yategerezwa kwegurirwa Uhoraho”.
Nuko Yosefu na Mariya baca batanga ikimazi nk’uko ivyo Vyagezwe vy’Uhoraho vyabitegekanya: “inyoni zitwa intunguru zibiri canke inuma zikiri nto zibiri.”
I Yerusalemu hari umugabo yitwa Simeyoni, yari umugororotsi kandi yubaha Imana. Yari yiteze kubona ukwirurwa kwa Isirayeli, kandi Mpwemu Yera yari kuri we.
Kandi yari yarahishuriwe na Mpwemu Yera ko atazopfa atabonye Kristo yasezeranywe n’Umwami Imana.
Arongowe na Mpwemu Yera, yinjira mu rusengero. Yosefu na Mariya bazanye Yesu mu rusengero kugira ngo bashitse ivyo ivyagezwe vyategekanya kuri we,
Simeyoni aramwakira, amukikira mu maboko yiwe, ashima Imana ati:
“Ubu rero, Mwami Imana, nk’uko wansezeraniye, urasezeye umusavyi wawe amahoro.
Kuko amaso yanje yiboneye agakiza,
ako wateguriye amahanga yose.
Ni umuco uzohishurira Abanyamahanga Imana, ni icubahiro ku bwoko bwawe bwa Isirayeli.”
Abavyeyi b’uwo mwana batangazwa cane n’ayo majambo amuvuzeko.

Nuko Simeyoni arabahezagira, maze abarira Mariya ati: “Uwu mwana ashizweho kugira ngo, muri Isirayeli, abantu benshi bagwe, abandi bavyuke. Azoba ikimenyetso kivuye ku Mana, ariko benshi bazomugwanya.
Ivyo bizotuma ivyiyumviro vyo mu mitima ya benshi bija ahabona. Kandi na wewe nyene, inkota izogusogota mu mutima.”
Hariho n’uwavugishwa n’Imana yitwa Hana, mwene Fanuweli, wo mu muryango wa Asheri, yari ashaje cane. Yabanye n’umugabo wiwe imyaka indwi gusa,
akaba yari amaze imyaka mirongo umunani n’ine ari umupfakazi. Yama mu rusengero ijoro n’umurango, akorera Imana, asenga kandi yisonzesha.
Ako kanya nyene, ashika aho bari aca atangura gushima Imana no kubwira abari biteze ugucungurwa kwa Yerusalemu bose inkuru z’uwo mwana.
Yosefu na Mariya bahejeje gukora ibitegekanijwe n’Ivyagezwe vy’Uhoraho, baca basubira i Galilaya mu gisagara cabo ca Nazareti.
Uwo mwana arakura, arakomera, agwiza ubwenge, kandi ubuntu bw’Imana bwari kuri we.
Uko umwaka utashe, abavyeyi ba Yesu bama baja i Yerusalemu mu misi mikuru ya Pasika.
Yesu amaze imyaka cumi n’ibiri, ajana na bo muri iyo misi mikuru nk’uko vyari bisanzwe.
Imisi mikuru irangiye, abavyeyi biwe barataha, ariko uwo mwana Yesu asigara i Yerusalemu, yamara abavyeyi biwe ntibabimenya.
Nuko bamara umusi wose bagenda, bibaza ko umwana yoba ari mu bandi bari bafatanije urugendo. Mu nyuma batangura kumuronderera mu ncuti n’abagenzi.
Bamubuze, basubira i Yerusalemu kumurondererayo.
Haheze imisi itatu, bamusanga mu rusengero yicaranye n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe, abumviriza yongera ababaza ibibazo.
Abamwumva bose baratangazwa n’ubwenge bwiwe hamwe n’inyishu ziwe.
Abavyeyi biwe bamubonye baratangara cane. Nyina aramubaza ati: “Mwana wanje, ibi watugiriye ni ibiki? Twe na so tumaze imisi duhagaritse imitima cane tukurondera.”
Yesu aramubaza ati: “Mbega mwandonderera iki? Ntimwari muzi ko ntegerezwa kuba mu nzu kwa Data?”
Ariko ntibatahura ico ababwiye.
Maze baca basubirana na we i Nazareti, kandi yama abumvira. Nuko nyina abika ivyo vyose mu mutima wiwe.
Yesu abandanya akura mu gihagararo, agwiza ubwenge, kandi agira ikiganza ciza ku Mana no ku bantu.

Mu mwaka ugira cumi na gatanu Kayisari Tiberiyo ari ku ngoma i Roma, Pontiyo Pilato na we ari icariho ciwe i Yudaya, Herode Antipa akaba umuganwa atwara intara ya Galilaya, uwo bavukana yitwa Filipo na we agatwara intara za Ituraya na Tirakoniti, hanyuma uwundi yitwa Lusaniya na we agatwara intara ya Abilene,
Anasi na Kayafa na bo bakaba ari abaherezi bakuru. Ico gihe ni ho ijambo ry’Imana ryaza kuri Yohana mwene Zakariya ari mu bugaragwa.
Nuko Yohana aja mu turere twose two hakurya no hakuno y’uruzi Yorodani, yigisha abantu umubatizo wo kwihana kugira ngo baharirwe ivyaha vyabo.
Ivyo vyari vyaranditswe mu gitabu c’amajambo y’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya, aho yavuga ati: “Hari ijwi ry’uwusemerera mu bugaragwa ati: ‘Nimutegurire Uhoraho aho aca, mugorore inzira agenderamwo!
Imyonga yose izokwuzuzwa iringanire, imisozi n’udutumba vyose bizosenwa. Amabarabara atagororotse azogororwa, n’inzira zisivye zizosiburwa, ziringanizwe.
Kandi abantu bose bazobona agakiza k’Imana.’”
Maze abantu benshi baja iyo Yohana ari ngo ababatize. Arababaza ati: “Mwa bana b’inzoka mwe, ni nde yababuriye ngo muhunge uburake bw’Imana bugiye kuza?

Nimukore ibikorwa vyerekana ko mwihanye, mureke kwibwira mu mitima yanyu muti: ‘Turi uruvyaro rwa Aburahamu.’ Kuko ndababwira ko, no muri aya mabuye mubona, Imana ishobora gukuramwo abana ba Aburahamu.
Mbere incabiti ibanguriwe kw’imerero ry’ibiti: igiti cose kitama ivyamwa vyiza kigiye gucibwa gitererwe mu muriro.”
Abantu benshi bari ngaho baramubaza bati: “None dukore iki?”
Yohana arabishura ati: “Uwufise imyambaro ibiri y’impuzu, nahe umwambaro umwe uwudafise n’umwe, n’uwufise ivyokurya nagire gutyo nyene.”
Abatozakori na bo baraza ngo ababatize. Baramubaza bati: “Mwigisha, dukore iki?”
Arabishura ati: “Ntimugatoze ibirengeye ivyemewe n’amategeko.”
Abasoda na bo nyene baramubaza bati: “Tweho dukore iki?” Arabishura ati: “Ntihakagire abo munyaga utwabo kandi ntihakagire uwo mudendereza. Mubumbwe n’impembo zanyu.”
Kubera abantu bari biteze cane ukuza kwa Kristo, bagumye bibaza mu mitima ku vyerekeye Yohana ko yoba ari we Kristo.
Nuko Yohana abwira bose ati: “Jewe ndababatiza mu mazi. Ariko hagiye kuza uwundusha ubushobozi; ntibimbereye no gupfundurura utugozi tw’ibirato vyiwe. We azobabatiza muri Mpwemu Yera no mu muriro.
Afise urutaro rwo kugosora mu minwe. Azokubura ikibanza co gusekuriramwo, ahejeje kugosora, azokwegeraniriza ingano mu kigega, umuguruka na wo awuturirire mu muriro utazokwigera uzima.”
Nuko Yohana abandanya abwira abantu Ubutumwa Bwiza burimwo amajambo menshi yo kubatera intege.
Ariko Yohana amaze kwagiriza ku mugaragaro Herode Antipa icaha co kurongora Herodiya, kandi yari asanzwe ari umugore w’uwo bavukana, akavuga n’ibindi bibi vyinshi yakoze,
Herode yaciye yongerako ikindi caha co gushira Yohana mw’ibohero.
Mu gihe abantu bose bariko barabatizwa, Yesu na we yabatijwe hamwe na bo. Ariko arasenga, ijuru riruguruka,
Mpwemu Yera amanuka kuri we mw’ishusho y’inuma. Maze ijwi ryumvikana rivuye mw’ijuru riti: “Uri umwana wanje nkunda akampimbara.”
Igihe Yesu yatangura igikorwa ciwe yari amaze hafi imyaka mirongo itatu. Abantu benshi bibaza ko Yesu ari mwene Yosefu, Yosefu mwene Heli,
Heli mwene Matati, Matati mwene Lewi, Lewi mwene Meliki, Meliki mwene Yanayi, Yanayi mwene Yosefu,
Yosefu mwene Matatiya, Matatiya mwene Amosi, Amosi mwene Nahumu, Nahumu mwene Esili, Esili mwene Nagayi,
Nagayi mwene Mayati, Mayati mwene Matatiya, Matatiya mwene Semeyini, Semeyini mwene Yoseki, Yoseki mwene Yoda,
Yoda mwene Yohanani, Yohanani mwene Resa, Resa mwene Zerubabeli, Zerubabeli mwene Shalutiyeli, Shalutiyeli mwene Neri,
Neri mwene Meliki, Meliki mwene Hadi, Hadi mwene Kosamu, Kosamu mwene Elumadamu, Elumadamu mwene Eri,
Eri mwene Yosuwa, Yosuwa mwene Eliyazeri, Eliyazeri mwene Yorimu, Yorimu mwene Matati, Matati mwene Lewi,
Lewi mwene Simeyoni, Simeyoni mwene Yuda, Yuda mwene Yosefu, Yosefu mwene Yonamu, Yonamu mwene Eliyakimu,
Eliyakimu mwene Meleya, Meleya mwene Mena, Mena mwene Matata, Matata mwene Natani, Natani mwene Dawidi,
Dawidi mwene Isayi, Isayi mwene Obedi, Obedi mwene Bowazi, Bowazi mwene Salumoni, Salumoni mwene Nahashoni,
Nahashoni mwene Aminadabu, Aminadabu mwene Ramu, Ramu mwene Hezironi, Hezironi mwene Peresi, Peresi mwene Yuda,
Yuda mwene Yakobo, Yakobo mwene Isaka, Isaka mwene Aburahamu, Aburahamu mwene Tera, Tera mwene Nahori,
Nahori mwene Serugi, Serugi mwene Reyu, Reyu mwene Pelegi, Pelegi mwene Eberi, Eberi mwene Shela,
Shela mwene Kayinani, Kayinani mwene Arupakisadi, Arupakisadi mwene Shemu, Shemu mwene Nowa, Nowa mwene Lameki,
Lameki mwene Metusela, Metusela mwene Enoki, Enoki mwene Yeredi, Yeredi mwene Mahalaleli, Mahalaleli mwene Kenani,
Kenani mwene Enoshi, Enoshi mwene Seti, Seti mwene Adamu, Adamu akomoka ku Mana.
Hanyuma Yesu, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, ava ku ruzi Yorodani ajanwa na Mpwemu mu bugaragwa,
ahamara imisi mirongo ine ageragezwa na Satani. Amara iyo misi ata co arya, maze iheze, yumva arashonje.
Satani aramubwira ati: “Niwaba uri Umwana w’Imana, bwira iri buye rihinduke umukate.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Handitswe ngo: ‘Umuntu ntabeshwaho n’ivyokurya gusa.’ ”
Hanyuma Satani amujana ahantu harehare, amwereka ubwami bwose bwo mw’isi mu kanya gato.
Aramubwira ati: “Ndaguha kuganza ubwo bwami, nguhe n’ubwiza bwabwo bwose, kuko narabuhawe kandi nshobora kubuha uwo nshatse wese.
Niwapfukama ukansenga, ivyo vyose biraba ivyawe.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Handitswe ngo: ‘Usenge Uhoraho Imana yawe, kandi abe ari yo yonyene ukorera!’ ”
Nuko wa mubi amujana i Yerusalemu, amuhagarika ku rusengero ahantu hataramutse, amubwira ati: “Niwaba uri Umwana w’Imana, niwikororere hasi,
kuko handitswe ngo: ‘Azotegeka abamarayika biwe bakuzigame.
Bazokurerura mu maboko yabo, kugira ngo ntutsitare kw’ibuye.’”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Handitswe ngo: ‘Ntukagerageze Uhoraho Imana yawe.’ ”
Satani ahejeje kumugerageza mu buryo bwose, aca amusiga aho, ntiyasubira kumugerageza gushika habonetse akandi karyo.
Yesu aca asubira i Galilaya yuzuye ubushobozi bwa Mpwemu Yera, maze inkuru yiwe ikwira akarere kose kahegereye.
Yama yigisha mu masinagogi yaho kandi agashimwa n’abantu bose.
Hanyuma Yesu aja i Nazareti aho yakuriye. Ku musi w’Isabato, yinjira mw’isinagogi nk’uko yari amenyereye, maze ahaguruka ngo asome Ivyanditswe.
Bamuhereza umuzingo w’igitabu c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya, arakizingurura, aca ashikira ahanditswe ngo:
“Mpwemu w’Uhoraho ari kuri jewe, kuko yansize amavuta ngo mbwire aboro Ubutumwa Bwiza. Yantumye kubwira imbohe ko zibohotse, abahumye ngo bahumuke, kurekura abacinyijwe ngo bidegemvye,
no kumenyekanisha umwaka wo kugirirwa ubuntu n’Uhoraho.”
Ahejeje gusoma, aca azinga uwo muzingo w’igitabu, awusubiza uwujejwe ububiko, aca aricara. Abari mw’isinagogi bose bamuhanga amaso cane,
na we aca atangura kubabwira ati: “Uwu musi ibi Vyanditswe mwumvise birashitse.”
Bose baramushima, batangazwa n’amajambo y’ubuntu ava mu kanwa kiwe, babazanya bati: “Mbega uwu si wa muhungu wa Yosefu?”

Yesu arababwira ati: “Ndazi ko mutazobura kuncira uwu mugani muti: ‘Muvuzi, niwivure!’ Kandi muzombwira muti: ‘Korera muri iki gisagara uvukamwo ibitangaza nk’ivyo twumvise wakoreye i Kaperinawumu!’ ”
Arabandanya ati: “Ndababwire ukuri, nta wuvugishwa n’Imana yemerwa iwabo.
Mu vy’ukuri, mu gihe ca Eliya hari abapfakazi benshi muri Isirayeli, aho ijuru ryugarwa imvura ikamara imyaka itatu n’igice itagwa, amapfa agatera mu gihugu cose.
Ariko Eliya ntiyarungitswe ku mupfakazi n’umwe muri bo, atari ku mupfakazi w’i Zerafati mu ntara ya Sidoni.
Kandi hari abanyamibembe benshi muri Isirayeli mu gihe c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Elisa, ariko nta n’umwe yahumanutse imibembe atari Namani Umusiriya.”
Abari mw’isinagogi bavyumvise, bose barashavura cane.
Barahaguruka, bamukwegera inyuma y’igisagara, bamujana hejuru ku musozi ico gisagara cari cubatsweko, kugira ngo bamutembagarize mu manga.
Ariko abaca hagati arigira.
Nuko Yesu aca aja i Kaperinawumu mu gisagara c’i Galilaya. Ku musi w’Isabato aja kwigisha mw’isinagogi,
maze abantu batangazwa n’inyigisho ziwe, kuko zarimwo ububasha.
Muri iyo sinagogi hari umuntu arimwo impwemu ihumanye. Maze akoma induru n’ijwi rirenga ati:
“Yesu w’i Nazareti, udushakako iki? Uzanywe no kuduhonya? Ndazi uwo uri we. Uri Uwera w’Imana!”
Yesu arayizibiza ati: “Hora! Muvemwo!” Uwo mudayimoni aca amukubita hasi imbere y’abantu bari ngaho, amuvamwo ata co amugize.
Abantu bose baratangara cane, barabwirana bati: “Ijambo ry’uwu muntu rirakomeye! Rifise ububasha n’inkomezi, kuko n’impwemu mbi na zo arazitegeka zikamwumvira, zigasohoka!”
Nuko inkuru ziwe zikwira muri ako karere kose.
Yesu aca ava muri iyo sinagogi aja i muhira kwa Simoni. Inabukwe wa Simoni yari agwaye kandi ashushe cane, maze abari ngaho binginga Yesu ngo amukize.
Yesu aramwegera, ahagarara i ruhande yiwe, akankamira ubwo bushuhe, buca burahera. Ako kanya nyene aca arahaguruka, arabazimana.
Izuba ririko rirarenga, bamuzanira abantu bose bafise ingwara zitandukanye, arambika ibiganza kuri umwumwe wese, arabakiza.
N’impwemu mbi zikava mu bantu benshi, zisemerera ziti: “Uri Umwana w’Imana!” Ariko yaca azikankamira, akazankira kubandanya zivuga, kuko zari zizi ko ari we Mesiya.
Bukeye mu gitondo, Yesu aja mu kibanza ciherereye. Abantu baja kumurondera, bamubonye, baramugobera ngo ntasubire kuvana na bo.
Ariko arababwira ati: “Ntegerezwa kuvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami bw’Imana no mu bindi bisagara na vyo, kuko ari co canzanye.”
Nuko abandanya yigisha mu masinagogi y’i Yudaya.
Umusi umwe Yesu yari ku nkengera y’ikiyaga c’i Genezareti, akikujwe n’isinzi ry’abantu bariko bumviriza ijambo ry’Imana.
Maze abona ubwato bubiri abarovyi bari basize ku nkengera y’ico kiyaga, bariko boza insenga zabo.
Nuko yurira bumwe muri bwo; kandi bwari ubwa Simoni, aca amusaba ngo abwigize gatoya mu mazi. Maze, aca abwicaramwo, atangura kwigisha abantu.
Ahejeje kwigisha, aca abarira Simoni ati: “Nimuterere insenga zanyu hagati mu kiyaga, murobe.”
Simoni aramwishura ati: “Mwigisha, twakoze ijoro ryose turaruha, ariko ntitwaronka ifi n’imwe. Yamara ko ubivuze, reka nterere insenga.”
Batereye insenga, baroba ifi nyishi cane, gushika n’aho insenga zitangura gutabuka.
Baca bahamagara bagenzi babo bari mu bundi bwato ngo baze babafashe, maze buzuza ubwato bwabo bwompi gushika aho butangura kwibira.
Simoni Petero abibonye, apfukama imbere ya Yesu, amubwira ati: “Mwami, igira kure yanje kuko ndi umunyavyaha!”
Ivyo Petero yabivuze kubera we na bagenziwe bari batangajwe cane n’ubwinshi bw’ifi bahejeje kuroba.
Abo bagenziwe, yari Yakobo na Yohana bene Zebedayo. Yesu abwira Simoni ati: “Ntutinye, kuko uhereye ubu, ugiye kuba umurovyi w’abantu.”
Baca bakwegera ubwato bwabo ku nkengera y’ikiyaga, basigaho vyose, baramukurikira.
Yesu ari muri kimwe mu bisagara vy’aho hantu, haza umuntu yuzuye imibembe umubiri wose. Abonye Yesu, yikubita imbere yiwe yubamye, aramwinginga ati: “Mwami, ubishatse woshobora kumpumanura.”
Yesu aca aramvura ukuboko, amukorako. Amubwira ati: “Ndabishatse, kira uhumanuke!” Ubwo nyene imibembe ica iramuvako.

Maze Yesu aramwihaniza ati: “Ntihagire umuntu n’umwe ubibwira. Ariko genda ku muherezi agusuzume, hanyuma utange ikimazi Mose yashinze ko uwuhumanutse atanga, kugira ngo bibabere ikimenyetso ko wahumanutse.”
Yamara inkuru za Yesu zirushirizaho kumenyekana, abantu isinzi bakama baza aho ari kumwumviriza no kugira ngo abakize ingwara.
Ariko Yesu yama aja ahantu hiherereye mu bugaragwa gusenga.

Umusi umwe Yesu yariko arigisha, kandi bamwe mu Bafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe bari ngaho; bari baje bava mu bisagara bitandukanye vy’i Galilaya, i Yudaya n’i Yerusalemu; kandi ububasha bw’Umwami Imana bwo gukiza ingwara bwari kuri Yesu.
Nuko haza abantu bateruye ku nderuzo umuntu akongataye, barondera ingene bomwinjiza mu nzu ngo bamuryamike imbere ya Yesu.
Babonye ko badashobora kwinjira kubera ubwinshi bw’abantu, baca burira hejuru ku nzu, basambura aho bacisha iyo nderuzo aryamyeko, bayururukiriza hagati mu bantu, imbere ya Yesu.
Yesu abonye ukwizera kwabo, avuga ati: “Mugenzi, ivyaha vyawe urabihariwe.”
Abafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe batangura kwiyumvira bati: “Mbega uwu ni nde aza gutuka Imana? Ni nde ashobora guharira ivyaha atari Imana yonyene?”
Yesu aca amenya ivyo bariko bariyumvira, maze arababaza ati: “Ni kuki muriko mwiyumvira gutyo mu mitima yanyu?
Mbega icoroshe ni uko novuga nti: ‘Ivyaha vyawe urabihariwe,’ canke ni uko novuga nti: ‘Haguruka ugende’?
Ariko nshaka ko mumenya ko Umwana w’Umuntu afise ububasha kw’isi bwo guharira ivyaha.” Aca ategeka wa muntu akongataye ati: “Haguruka, ikorere inderuzo yawe witahire.”
Ubwo nyene aca arahaguruka bose babibona, yikorera ico yari aryamyeko, ataha ahimbaza Imana.
Abari ngaho bose baratangara cane kandi bagira n’ubwoba, bahimbaza Imana bavuga bati: “Uwu musi amaso yacu abonye ibitangaza!”
Inyuma y’ivyo, Yesu ariko arava muri ico gisagara, abona umutozakori yitwa Lewi yicaye aho yatoreza ikori, amubwira ati: “Nkurikira!”
Lewi aca ava hasi, aramukurikira.
Mu nyuma Lewi ategurira amazimano Yesu i muhira iwe, atumira n’abatozakori benshi n’abandi bantu, baraza basangira na bo.
Ariko Abafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe babaza abigishwa ba Yesu babidodombera bati: “Ni kuki mwicarana n’abatozakori n’abandi banyavyaha, mugasangira na bo?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Abakomeye si bo bakeneye umuganga, ahubwo abagwaye ni bo bamukeneye.
Sinaje kurondera abagororotsi, ahubwo naje kurondera abanyavyaha, kugira ngo bihane.”
Baca baramubaza bati: “Ni kuki abigishwa ba Yohana, co kimwe n’ab’Abafarisayo bisonzesha kenshi bakongera bagasenga, ariko abawe bakaguma birira kandi binywera nk’uko bisanzwe?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Mbega abatumire b’umukwe bokwisonzesha bakiri kumwe na we mu musi mukuru? Ntibishoboka!
Ariko hazogera aho umukwe abakurwamwo; ico gihe rero bazoheza bisonzeshe.”

Aca abacira uwu mugani ati: “Nta wutabura igitambara ku mpuzu nshasha ngo akibaririre ku mpuzu y’umushire. Abikoze uko, aba yononye iyo mpuzu nshasha, kandi ico gitambara gishasha ntigishobora gufatana n’impuzu y’umushire.
Ni nk’uko ata wosuka umuvinyu mushasha mu mukuza w’urusato ushaje. Abigize uko, uwo mukuza womeneka, umuvinyu ugaseseka.
Ahubwo umuvinyu mushasha bawushira mu mukuza mushasha.
Kandi nta muntu anywa umuvinyu wa kera ngo aheze yipfuze kunywa mushasha, kuko avuga ngo: ‘Umuvinyu wa kera ni wo uryoshe kuruta mushasha.’ ”
Umusi umwe, Yesu yaciye mu mirima y’ingano, kandi hari kw’Isabato. Abigishwa biwe baca batangura guca imitwe y’ingano zeze, barazivungura, bakuramwo intete, barazirya.
Bamwe mu Bafarisayo baramubaza bati: “Ni kuki mukora ikizira ku musi w’Isabato?”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Mbega ntimurasoma ivyo Dawidi yakoze igihe we n’abo bari kumwe bari bashonje?
Yinjiye mu nzu y’Imana, afata imikate yashikaniwe Imana arayirya, yongera ahako n’abari kumwe na we; kandi abaherezi ari bo bonyene bari bemerewe kuyirya.”
Yongera arababwira ati: “Umwana w’Umuntu ni Umwami w’Isabato.”
Ku wundi musi w’Isabato, Yesu yinjira mw’isinagogi, atangura kwigisha. Aho hari umugabo akongataye ukuboko kw’i buryo.
Abafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe baca bamushinga ijisho kugira ngo barabe ko amukiza, maze bace bamwagiriza ko yakijije umuntu kw’Isabato.
Ariko Yesu amenye ivyo biyumvira mu mitima, aca abarira wa mugabo akongataye ukuboko ati: “Haguruka uhagarare hano imbere y’ishengero!” Nuko arahaguruka, ahagarara imbere.
Maze Yesu arababaza ati: “Mbega icemewe gukorwa ku musi w’Isabato ni ikihe? Iciza canke ikibi? Gukiza umuntu canke kumwica?”
Nuko Yesu arabitegereza bose, maze abwira wa muntu ati: “Gorora ukuboko kwawe!” Akugoroye, guca kurakira.
Ariko ba Bafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe barashavura cane, batangura kuja inama babazanya bati: “Yesu tumugire dute?”
Umusi umwe Yesu aduga ku musozi, akesha ijoro ryose asenga Imana.
Bukeye, akoranya abigishwa biwe bose, atoranyamwo cumi na babiri, abagira intumwa. Na bo ni aba:
Simoni, uwo Yesu yise Petero, mwene nyina Andereya, Yakobo, Yohana, Filipo, Baruteremi,
Matayo, Toma, Yakobo mwene Alufayo, Simoni Umuzelote,
Yuda mwene Yakobo, na Yuda Isikariyote, ari we yahavuye amugurisha.

Hanyuma Yesu ava kuri uwo musozi amanukana na bo, bashika ahantu hateze, bahasanga abigishwa biwe benshi, hamwe n’abandi bantu isinzi bari baje bava i Yudaya, i Yerusalemu, no mu micungararo y’intara za Tiro na Sidoni yegereye ikiyaga,
bazanywe no kumwumviriza no kugira ngo abakize ingwara. Nuko abari baboshwe n’impwemu mbi barakira,
kandi abantu bose bagerageza kumukorako, kuko ububasha bwo gukiza ingwara bwamuvamwo bugakiza abantu bose.
Nuko Yesu yitegereza abigishwa biwe, aravuga ati: “Murahiriwe mwebwe mwumva ko mukenye, kuko Ubwami bw’Imana ari ubwanyu.
Murahiriwe mwebwe mushonje muri kino gihe, kuko muzohazwa. Murahiriwe mwebwe murira muri kino gihe, kuko muzotwenga.
Muzoba muhiriwe abantu nibabanka, bakabakumira, bakabatuka, bakabavuga nabi nk’inkozi z’ibibi, babahora Umwana w’Umuntu.
Ico gihe muze munezerwe kuko impera yanyu izoba ari nini mw’ijuru. Kandi mwibuke ko ba sekuruza babo ari ko bagiriye abavugishwa n’Imana ba kera.
Ariko muragowe mwebwe abatunzi, kuko mumaze kuronka umunezero wanyu.
Muragowe mwebwe muhaze muri kino gihe, kuko muzosonza. Muragowe mwebwe mutwenga muri kino gihe, kuko muzobabara muboroge.
Muragowe mwebwe mushimagizwa na bose, kuko uko ari ko ba sekuruza babo bashimagiza abavugishwa b’ibinyoma.
Ariko ndababwire mwebwe munyumva: mukunde abansi banyu, mugirire neza ababanka.
Muhezagire ababavuma, musengere ababagirira nabi.
Nihagira uwugukubita mu musaya umwe, umuhindukirize n’uwundi. Hagize uwugutwara ikoti, umuhebere n’ishati na yo.
Umuntu niyagusaba ikintu ukimuhe, uwukunyaze ivyawe ubimuhebere.
Ivyo mugomba ko abantu babagirira, abe ari vyo mubagirira namwe.
Nimwakunda ababakunda gusa, muzoba murushije iki abandi? Kuko n’abanyavyaha bakunda ababakunda.
Kandi nimwagirira neza ababagirira neza gusa, muzoba murushije iki abandi? Mbega abanyavyaha bo ntibabigenza batyo?
Nimwagurana abo mwizeye ko bazobasubiza bonyene, muzoba murushije iki abandi? Mbega abanyavyaha bo ntibagurana abo bizeye ko bazobasubiza yose?

Ariko, mukunde abansi banyu, mubagirire neza. Mubagurane mutiteze ko babasubiza, ni ho impera yanyu izoba nini mw’ijuru. Aho muzoba mwerekanye vy’ukuri ko muri abana b’Iyisumbavyose, kuko igirira neza intashima n’abanyakibi.
Mugire impuhwe nk’uko So wo mw’ijuru ari umunyempuhwe.
Ntimugacire imanza abandi, kugira ngo namwe ntimuzozicirwe. Ntimugatsindishe abandi, kugira ngo namwe ntimuzotsindishwe. Mugire imbabazi, ni ho namwe muzozigirirwa.
Mutange, namwe muzohabwa. Ingero nziza, itsindagiye, inyingishe kandi isesekaye ni yo muzogererwa. Kuko ingero mugereramwo abandi ari yo namwe muzogererwamwo.”
Yesu abacira n’uwu mugani ati: “Mbega impumyi yorongora iyindi? Zose ntizohava zigwa mu kinogo?
Umwigishwa ntaruta umwigisha, ariko umwigishwa yigishijwe neza amera nk’umwigisha wiwe.
Ni kuki ushinga ijisho akatsi kari mu jisho rya mugenzawe, ariko ntiwiteho inkingi y’igiti iri mu jisho ryawe?

Ni kuki ubwira mugenzawe uti: ‘Tega ndagutosore akatsi kari mu jisho,’ kandi nawe ugendana inkingi y’igiti mu jisho ryawe? Wa ndyarya we, tangura ukure inkingi y’igiti iri mu jisho ryawe, ni ho uzobona neza akatsi kari mu jisho rya mugenzawe, uheze ugakureyo.
Nta giti ciza cama ivyamwa bibi, kandi nta giti kibi cama ivyamwa vyiza.
Igiti cose kimenyekanira ku vyamwa vyaco. Nta wokwamura inzabibu ku bisaka vy’amahwa, nk’uko ata wokwamura insukoni ku mitobotobo.
Umuntu mwiza akura ivyiza mu bubiko bwiza bw’umutima wiwe, umubi na we agakura ibibi mu bubiko bubi bw’umutima wiwe. Kuko ivyuzuye mu mutima ni vyo akanwa kavuga.
Ni kuki mumpamagara ngo: ‘Mwami, Mwami,’ ariko ntimukore ivyo ndababwira?
Umuntu wese aza aho ndi akumva amajambo yanje hanyuma akayashira mu ngiro, ngira ndabereke uko ameze:
ameze nk’umwubatsi yimvye cane akubaka umushinge w’inzu yiwe ku rutare. Iyo hateye umwuzure, inzuzi zigasuriranya, iyo nzu ntishobora kunyiganyiga kuko yubatse neza.
Ariko uwumva amajambo yanje ntayashire mu ngiro, ameze nk’uwubaka inzu kw’isi ahatagira umushinge. Iyo inzuzi zisuriranije kuri ya nzu, irasenyuka kandi isenyuka ryayo riba irikomeye.”

headings.text: Yesu yerekana abahiriwe abo ari bo

verses.text: Yesu ahejeje kwigisha abantu muri ayo majambo yose, aca aja i Kaperinawumu.
Aho hari umusoda mukuru w’Umuroma yari afise umukozi yakunda cane. Uwo mukozi yari agwaye, ari hafi yo gupfa.
Yumvise inkuru za Yesu, aca arungika bamwe mu bakuru b’Abayuda, ngo bamwinginge aze akize umukozi wiwe.
Bashitse aho Yesu ari, baramwinginga bashimitse bati: “Uwu muntu birakwiye ko umufasha,
kuko arakunda ihanga ryacu kandi yaratwubakiye n’isinagogi.”
Yesu aca ajana na bo. Ari hafi yo gushika, wa musoda aca arungika abagenzi biwe ngo baje kumubwira bati: “Mwami, ntiwirirwe urigora, kuko ntibimbereye kukwakira mu nzu yanje.
Simbereye no kuza aho uri ngo duhure. Ariko vuga ijambo rimwe gusa, umukozi wanje arakira.

Kuko nanje ndafise abantegeka kandi mfise n’abasoda ntegeka. Iyo mbwiye umwe nti: ‘Genda,’ aca agenda; nabwira uwundi nti: ‘Ngwino,’ agaca aza; kandi iyo mbwiye umukozi wanje nti ‘Kora iki,’ aca agikora.”
Yesu avyumvise aratangara cane, aca arahindukira abarira abo bari kumwe ati: “Ndababwire ukuri, sinari bwabone uwufise ukwizera gukomeye nk’uku no muri Isirayeli.”
Maze bamwe bari batumwe baragaruka, basanga wa mukozi yakize.
Inyuma y’ivyo Yesu aca amanuka mu gisagara citwa Nayini, ari kumwe n’abigishwa hamwe n’isinzi ry’abantu bamukurikiye.
Ageze hafi y’irembo ry’igisagara, haza abantu bagiye guhamba umuntu. Yari umuhungu w’ikinege kandi nyina yari umupfakazi. Hariho kandi n’isinzi ry’abantu bo muri ico gisagara bari bamuherekeje.
Umwami Yesu abonye uwo muvyeyi, amugirira impuhwe, aca amubwira ati: “Reka kurira!”
Maze Yesu yegera isandugu yarimwo ikiziga, abari bayiteruye baca barahagarara. Hanyuma avuga ati: “Muhungu, ndakubwiye, haguruka!”
Wa muhungu yari yapfuye aravyuka, atangura kuvuga, Yesu aca amusubiza nyina.
Abari aho bose baterwa n’ubwoba, bongera bashima Imana, bati: “Uwuvugishwa n’Imana ahambaye yatwiyeretse, Imana yaje gutabara abantu bayo.”
Nuko inkuru ya Yesu ikwira i Yudaya hose no mu micungararo yaho.
Maze abigishwa ba Yohana Umubatizi baragenda bamubwira ivyo Yesu ariko arakora vyose. Aca ahamagara babiri muri bo,
abatuma kubaza Umwami Yesu bati: “Mbega ni wewe twari twiteze ko uzoza canke twitege uwundi?”
Bashikiriye Yesu bamubwira bati: “Yohana Umubatizi adutumye ngo tukubaze: ‘Woba uri umwe yategerezwa kuza, canke turindire uwundi?’ ”
Ako kanya nyene Yesu aca akiza abantu benshi bari bafise ingwara n’ubumuga butandukanye, ababoshwe n’impwemu mbi, ahumura n’impumyi nyinshi.

Maze abarira ba bigishwa ati: “Genda mubarire Yohana ivyo mwabonye n’ivyo mwumvise: abahumye barahumuka, abamugaye baragenda, abanyamibembe barahumanuka, abatumva barumva, abapfuye barazuka, kandi aboro barabwirwa Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Hahiriwe umuntu adatsitazwa n’ivyanje.”
Ba bigishwa bamaze kugenda, Yesu aca atangura kuvuga ivyerekeye Yohana Umubatizi, ati: “Mbega mwagiye kuraba iki mu bugaragwa? Ni irenga rizungagizwa n’umuyaga?
Nimba atari uko, mwari mwagiye kuraba iki? Umuntu yambaye impuzu z’igiciro kinini? Si vyo, kuko abambara impuzu z’igiciro kinini, n’abiyamira mu bikayangana baba mu ngoro z’abami.
None mwagiye kuraba iki? Uwuvugishwa n’Imana? Ego cane, mbere ndababwiye ko mwagiye kuraba uwuruta uwuvugishwa n’Imana.
Kuko uwo ni we Ivyanditswe bivugako ngo: ‘Ngira ndungike intumwa yanje imbere yawe, igutegurire inzira.’
Ndababwire ukuri, mu bantu bose bavyawe n’abagore, nta wuruta Yohana; ariko umuntu mutoya musi y’abandi mu Bwami bw’Imana arahambaye kumuruta.”
Maze abantu bose, harimwo n’abatozakori, bumvise ayo majambo ya Yesu, baca baremera ko inzira z’Imana zigororotse, kuko bari babatijwe na Yohana.
Ariko Abafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe bo baranse umugambi w’Imana kuri bo, kuko banse ko Yohana ababatiza.
Yesu yongera kubabwira ati: “Mbega ab’uru runganwe nobagereranya n’iki? Bameze gute?
Bameze nk’abana bicaye ku mbuga, bahamagara bagenzi babo bakababarira bati: ‘Twabavugirije umwironge, ariko ntimwatamvye; hanyuma tubaririmbira indirimbo z’ikigandaro, ntimwarira.’
Kuko Yohana Umubatizi yaje atarya, atanywa n’umuvinyu, muca muvuga ngo: ‘Arimwo dayimoni.’
Umwana w’Umuntu na we aza arya, kandi anywa, muca muvuga ngo: ‘Ni umukunzi w’inda kandi ni imborerwa, agendana n’abatozakori n’abandi banyavyaha.’
Ariko icerekana ubwenge bw’Imana ni ubuzima bw’ababwakiriye.”
Maze umwe mu Bafarisayo atumira Yesu ngo amuzimane. Nuko Yesu aragenda, yinjira mu nzu yiwe, yicara ku meza.
Hanyuma umugore umwe wo muri ico gisagara yari azwi nk’umunyavyaha yumva ko Yesu ariko afungurira mu nzu y’uwo Mufarisayo. Aca aza azanye icupa ririmwo amavuta amota cane y’igiciro kinini,
apfukama i ruhande y’ibirenge vya Yesu arira, ajojotereza amosozi yiwe ku birenge vya Yesu, abihanaguza umushatsi wiwe, arabisomagura yongera abisiga ya mavuta.
Wa Mufarisayo yamutumira abibonye, atangura kwivugana mu mutima ati: “Iyaba uwu muntu yari uwuvugishwa n’Imana, yari kumenya uwuriko aramukorako, n’ubuzima bw’uwo mugore, ko ari umunyavyaha.”
Yesu aca aramubwira ati: “Simoni, ndafise ico ndakubwira.” Simoni na we ati: “Mbarira, Mwigisha!”
Yesu aca amucira umugani ati: “Habaye muntu yaguranye idenariyo abantu babiri. Umwe amuha amajana atanu, uwundi mirongo itanu.
Abonye ata n’umwe muri abo ashoboye kumwishura, aca azibahebera bompi. None ni nde muri abo babiri azomukunda cane?”
Simoni na we arishura ati: “Nibaza ko ari uwo yahebewe menshi.” Yesu aca amubwira ati: “Wishuye neza.”

Aca arahindukira araba wa mugore, hanyuma abwira Simoni ati: “Wabonye uwu mugore? Aho ninjira mu nzu yawe ntiwampaye amazi yo kwoza ibirenge, ariko we yatotesheje ibirenge vyanje n’amosozi yiwe, abihanaguza umushatsi wiwe.
Ntiwangumbiriye mu kundamutsa, ariko kuva ninjira ntahengeshanya kunsomagura ku birenge.
Ntiwansize amavuta ku mutwe, ariko we yansize amavuta amota cane ku birenge.
Ni co gituma, nanje ndakubwiye ko, yerekanye urukundo rwinshi kuko yahariwe ivyaha vyiwe vyinshi. Ariko uwahariwe bike, yerekana urukundo ruke.”
Yesu aca abarira wa mugore ati: “Ivyaha vyawe urabihariwe.”
Abandi batumire baca batangura kubazanya bati: “Mbega uwu ni nde, aho yubahuka kuvuga ko aharira abantu ivyaha?”
Yesu aca abarira wa mugore ati: “Ukwizera kwawe gutumye uronka agakiza, igire amahoro.”
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Yesu agendagenda mu bisagara no mu mihana, avuga Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Ubwami bw’Imana. Bamwe cumi na babiri bari kumwe na we,
hamwe n’abagore yabohoye baboshwe n’impwemu mbi, akabakiza n’izindi ngwara, ari bo Mariya Magadalena yirukanywemwo abadayimoni indwi,
Yowana muka Kuza; umunyabigega wa Herode, Suzana hamwe n’abandi benshi. Abo bagore bashigikira Yesu n’abigishwa biwe bakoresheje uburyo bwabo.
Umusi umwe, abantu benshi bari bakoranye bavuye mu bisagara bitandukanye, maze Yesu abacira uwu mugani ati:
“Habaye umurimyi yagiye kubiba imbuto ziwe. Ariko arabiba, zimwe zigwa i ruhande y’inzira, maze abantu barazihonyanga, kandi inyoni zo mu kirere ziraza zirazinobagura.
Izindi zigwa ku rutare; zimeze zica ziruma kuko hatari habomvye.
Izindi na zo zigwa mu mahwa; zimeze zikurana na yo, aca arazinyoha.
Ariko hariho n’izaguye mw’ivu ryiza, zirakura kandi zirama, zimbuka incuro ijana.” Ahejeje kubacira uwo mugani, yongerako ati: “Uwufise amatwi yumva, niyumve.”
Abigishwa biwe baca bamubaza insiguro y’uwo mugani.
Na we ababwira ati: “Ni mwebwe mwahawe kumenya amabanga y’ivy’Ubwami bw’Imana. Ariko ku bandi nkoresha imigani kugira ngo, ‘naho baraba ntibabone, kandi naho bumviriza ntibatahure.’
Iyi ni yo nsiguro y’uwu mugani: imbuto ni ijambo ry’Imana.
Imbuto zaguye aho abantu baca, ni abantu bumva Ijambo ry’Imana, ariko Satani agaca aza akarikura mu mitima yabo kugira ngo ntibizere, maze ngo bakizwe.
Imbuto zaguye ku rutare: ni abantu bakirana umunezero, ijambo ry’Imana, ariko kubera batarireka ngo rishinge imizi muri bo, bizera akanya gato. Hagize ibibagerageza, baca bata ukwizera.

Imbuto zaguye mu mahwa: ni abantu bamaze kwumva ijambo ry’Imana, imyitwarariko y’ivy’ubu buzima, ubutunzi n’ibihimbaro vy’iyi si bica biza bikanyoha iryo jambo ryatewe muri bo, hanyuma mu buzima bwabo ntibigere bakura, ngo bame imbuto nziza.
Ariko imbuto zaguye mw’ivu ryiza, ni abantu bamaze kwumva ijambo ry’Imana, baryakirana umutima mwiza kandi ukunze, maze bakarigumya; hanyuma kubera ukwihangana, bakama ivyamwa vyinshi.
Nta wudomeka itara hanyuma ngo aryubikeko igiseke canke ngo arinyegeze musi y’uburiri. Ahubwo aritereka ku giterekwako itara kugira ngo riboneshereze abinjira mu nzu.
Kuko ata canyegejwe kitazoshirwa ahabona, kandi ata cagizwe ibanga kitazomenyekana.
Nuko rero mwiyubare ku vyo mwumva. Uwufise azokwongererezwa, uwudafise na we azokwakwa n’ivyo yari afise.”
Nyina wa Yesu na bene nyina baje kumuraba babura aho baca ngo bamushikire kuko hari abantu benshi cane.
Umuntu umwe aca amubwira ati: “Nyoko na bene nyoko bahagaze hanze, bariko barakurondera.”
Yesu amwishura ati: “Mama na bene mama ni abo bumva ijambo ry’Imana bakaryumvira.”
Umusi umwe Yesu yabariye abigishwa biwe ati: “Tujabuke tuje hakurya y’ikiyaga.” Nuko batambukira mu bwato, bafata urugendo.
Bakiriko barasoza, Yesu arasinzira. Haca haduka umuyaga mwinshi mu kiyaga, maze ubwato butangura kwuzura amazi; bari bageramiwe cane.
Abigishwa baca baja kumuvyura bavuga bati: “Mwigisha, mwigisha, turapfuye!” Nuko aravyuka akankamira uwo muyaga n’imipfunda, igihuhusi kirahagarara, ubwo nyene haba agahwekere!
Yesu aca abaza ba bigishwa ati: “Ukwizera kwanyu kuri he?” Maze baratangara, bagira n’ubwoba bwinshi, batangura kubazanya bati: “Mbega uwu ni umuntu ki? Ategeka umuyaga n’amazi kandi bikamwumvira!”
Nuko barasoza bashika mu ntara ya Gerasene, hakurya y’ikiyaga harabana n’i Galilaya.
Yesu atambukiye ku nkengera y’ikiyaga, asanganirwa n’umugabo yarimwo abadayimoni, aje ava mu gisagara. Yari amaze igihe kirekire atambara impuzu canke ngo abe mu nzu; yaba mw’itongo ry’abapfuye.
Abonye Yesu, aca akoma induru, yikubita ku birenge vyiwe, asemerera n’ijwi rirenga ati: “Undonderako iki ga Yesu, Mwana w’Imana Musumbavyose? Ndakwinginze ntunkubagure imibabaro!”

Ivyo yabivuze kuko Yesu yari yategetse iyo mpwemu mbi kumuvamwo. Kenshi iyo mpwemu mbi imufashe, naho bamubohesha iminyororo n’amaguru yiwe bakayashira mu vyuma kugira ngo agume hamwe, yarabicagagura, iyo mpwemu mbi igaca imutwara kuyerera mu gahinga.
Yesu arayibaza ati: “Witwa nde?” Na yo iramwishura iti: “Nitwa Gitero,” kuko yarimwo abadayimoni benshi.
Abo badayimoni binginga Yesu ngo ntabarungike i kuzimu.
Hafi y’aho hari umukuku w’ingurube nyinshi zari ziragiwe ku musozi. Abo badayimoni binginga Yesu ngo abarungike muri izo ngurube, maze arabemerera.
Nuko ba badayimoni bava muri wa muntu, binjira muri za ngurube, na zo ziriruka zimanuka, zisuka mu kiyaga ziradwibira, zicwa n’amazi.
Abari baragiye izo ngurube babibonye baca bariruka, baja kubivuga mu gisagara no mu mihana.
Maze abantu bava mu gisagara baza kuraba ivyabaye. Bashitse aho Yesu ari, babona uwo muntu yavuyemwo abadayimoni, yicaye imbere ya Yesu, yambaye kandi afise ubwenge bukwiye, na bo bagira ubwoba.
Ababonye uko vyagenze baca babiganira ingene uwo muntu yari aboshwe n’abadayimoni yakize.
Nuko abantu bose bo mu ntara y’Abagerasene binginga Yesu ngo abavireho, kuko bari bagize ubwoba bwinshi. Yesu aca yurira ubwato arigira.
Wa mugabo yakize abadayimoni yinginga Yesu ngo bajane, ariko Yesu aramurungika, amubwira ati:
“Subira i muhira ubarire abantu ivyo Imana yagukoreye.” Wa muntu aca arataha aca hose mu gisagara, agenda arabwira abantu ivyo Yesu yamukoreye.
Yesu asubiye inyuma asanganirwa n’abantu benshi cane bari bamurindiriye.
Umugabo yitwa Yayiro, yari umukuru w’isinagogi, araza yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vya Yesu aramwinginga ngo bajane i muhira iwe,
kuko umukobwa wiwe yariko aracikana. Yari amufise ari umwe kandi yari afise imyaka nka cumi n’ibiri. Yesu ari mu nzira agenda, yari akikijwe n’abantu benshi bamugunda.
Hariho umugore yari amaze imyaka cumi n’ibiri agwaye ingwara yo mu gitereko yo kuguma ava amaraso, vyaranse ko akira.
Aca yegera Yesu amuturutse inyuma, akora ku musozo w’impuzu yiwe. Ubwo nyene kwa kuva amaraso guca kurahera.
Yesu na we aca arabaza ati: “Ni nde ankozeko?” Bose babihakanye, Petero amubwira ati: “Mwigisha, abantu ni benshi kandi bariko barakugunda.”
Yesu aravuga ati: “Hari umuntu yankozeko kuko hari ubushobozi numvise bumvuyemwo.”
Wa mugore abonye ko ico yakoze camenyekanye, aca aza ajugumira, yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vya Yesu, amubwirira imbere ya bose icatumye amukorako, kandi ko yaciye akira ako kanya nyene.
Yesu aca aramubwira ati: “Mwana wanje, ukwizera kwawe kuragukijije. Igire amahoro.”
Akiriko aravuga, haza umuntu avuye kwa Yayiro, wa mukuru w’isinagogi, amubwira ati: “Umukobwa wawe yamaze gucikana. Nta co ubandanya ugora umwigisha.”
Yesu nawe avyumvise aca abwira Yayiro ati: “Ntutinye, ariko wizere gusa, araja gukira.”
Ashitse mu nzu kwa Yayiro ntiyemera ko hagira umuntu n’umwe binjirana, kiretse Petero, Yohana, na Yakobo, hamwe na se na nyina b’uwo mwana.
Ico gihe abantu bose bariko baramuririra. Yesu arababarira ati: “Nta co murira kuko ntiyapfuye, ahubwo arasinziriye.”
Na bo baramutwenga, kuko bari bazi neza ko umwana yapfuye.
Yesu aca afata ukuboko kwa wa mukobwa, amubwira ati: “Mwana wanje, vyuka!”
Ubwo nyene impwemu yiwe imusubiramwo, arahaguruka. Maze Yesu ababwira ngo bamugaburire.
Abavyeyi biwe baratangara cane, ariko Yesu arabihanikiriza ngo ntihagire uwo babwira ivyabaye.

headings.text: Nyina wa Yesu na bene nyina
Umukobwa yari yapfuye n’umugore yari agwaye

verses.text: Yesu akoranya bamwe cumi na babiri, abaha ububasha bwo kwirukana abadayimoni no gukiza ingwara,
aca abarungika kwigisha ivy’Ubwami bw’Imana no gukiza abagwaye.
Arababarira ati: “Ntihagire ikintu na kimwe mujana ku rugendo, yaba inkoni, umufuko, ivyokurya, amahera, canke impuzu zo gukuranya.
Aho bazobakira, muzogume muri iyo nzu nyene gushika muvuye muri ico gisagara.
Aho batazobakira, muzokunkumure umukungugu wo mu birenge vyanyu, kugira ngo bizobabere icagiriji.”
Nuko baca bafata inzira, baca mu mihana itandukanye, bavuga Ubutumwa Bwiza, bakiza n’abagwaye aho baca hose.
Herode Antipa yumvise ivyo Yesu akora, arazazanirwa, kuko hariho abavuga ko yoba ari Yohana Umubatizi yazutse mu bapfuye,
abandi bakavuga ko yoba ari Eliya yabiyeretse, abandi na bo bakibaza ngo ni umwe mu bavugishwa n’Imana ba kera yoba yazutse mu bapfuye.
Ariko Herode aravuga ati: “Ko Yohana ari jewe namuciye umutwe, uwo we numva ni nde?” Ni ko guca arondera ingene yomubona.
Intumwa zigarutse ziganira Yesu ivyo zakoze vyose. Yesu aca ajana na bo baja ahiherereye, aharabana n’igisagara citwa Betesayida,
ariko abantu barabimenya, baca baramukurikira. Yesu arabakira, aca atangura kubabwira ivy’Ubwami bw’Imana, akiza n’abari bagwaye.
Buriko burira, bamwe cumi na babiri baza aho Yesu ari bamubwira bati: “Erega rungika aba bantu baje mu bisagara no mu mihana kurondera ivyokurya n’indaro, kuko turi mu gahinga.”
Arabishura ati: “Nimubagaburire mwebwe nyene.” Na bo bamubwira bati: “Dufise imikate itanu n’ifi zibiri gusa. None ushaka ko tuja gusuma ibikwiye isinzi ry’abantu nk’iri?”
(Ico gihe hari abagabo nk’ibihumbi bitanu.) Ariko Yesu abarira abigishwa biwe ati: “Nimubicarike mu migwi ya mirongo itanu itanu.”
Nuko abantu bose baricara.
Aca afata ya mikate itanu na za fi zibiri, araba mw’ijuru, abishimira Imana. Hanyuma arabimanyagura, abihereza abigishwa ngo bagaburire abantu.
Bose bararya kandi barahaga. Hanyuma abigishwa begeranya ibiseke cumi na bibiri vyuzuye utumanyu twasigaye.
Umusi umwe Yesu yariko arasenga yiherereye, ari kumwe n’abigishwa biwe. Arababaza ati: “Mbega abantu bavuga ko ndi nde?”
Baramwishura bati: “Bamwe bavuga ngo uri Yohana Umubatizi, abandi ngo uri Eliya, abandi na bo ngo uri umwe mu bavugishwa n’Imana ba kera yazutse.”
Aca arababaza ati: “None mweho muvuga ko ndi nde?” Petero aramwishura ati: “Uri Kristo yaje ava ku Mana.”
Yesu aca arabihaniza ashimitse ngo ntihagire uwo babibwira.

Ivyo biheze, ababwira ati: “Umwana w’Umuntu ategerezwa kubabazwa mu buryo bwinshi, akankwa n’abatware, n’abaherezi bakurubakuru, n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe. Kandi azokwicwa hanyuma azuke ku musi ugira gatatu.”
Yongera kubabwirira bose hamwe ati: “Uwugomba kunkurikira, ni yihebe, yikorere umusaraba wiwe ku musi ku musi, ankurikire.
Kuko uwugomba gukiza ubugingo bwiwe azobubura, ariko uwubuheba ku bwanje azobukiza.
Umuntu vyomumarira iki yungutse ivyo mw’isi vyose, ariko akabura ubugingo bwiwe canke akabutikiza?
Umuntu wese azogira isoni zo kunyemera no kwemera amajambo yanje, Umwana w’Umuntu na we azogira isoni zo kumwemera niyagaruka ari mu bwiza bwiwe, mu bwa Data no mu bw’abamarayika biwe bera.
Ndababwire ukuri, bamwe mu bo turi kumwe hano ntibazopfa batabonye Ubwami bw’Imana.”
Haheze nk’imisi umunani Yesu ababwiye ivyo, aca ajana Petero, Yohana na Yakobo, baduga ku musozi gusenga.
Akiriko arasenga, mu maso hiwe hahinduka ukundi, impuzu ziwe zirakayangana, zica ibibatsi.
Ubwo nyene haboneka abantu babiri: Mose na Eliya,
bari mu bwiza bw’Imana, batangura kuganira na Yesu, bavugana ingene yari agiye kurangiza igikorwa ciwe mu gupfira i Yerusalemu.
Petero na bagenziwe bari basinziriye cane; bikanguye babona ubwiza bwa Yesu, na ba bagabo bari bahagararanye na we.

Mose na Eliya bakiriko baratandukana na Yesu, Petero aramubarira ati: “Mwigisha, bitubereye vyiza kuba hano. Reka tuhashinge amahema atatu: iryawe, irya Mose, n’irya Eliya.” (Ariko Petero ntiyari azi ivyo ariko aravuga.)
Akiriko aravuga, igicu kiraza kirabapfuka. Abo bigishwa bagira ubwoba bwinshi igicu kibatwikiriye.
Maze humvikana ijwi muri ico gicu, rivuga riti: “Uwu ni Umwana wanje natoranije. Nimumwumvirize!”
Iryo jwi rihejeje kwumvikana, basanga Yesu asigaye ari wenyene. Ba bigishwa baca barahora, muri iyo misi ntibabwira umuntu n’umwe ivyo babonye.
Bukeye, bariko baramanuka bava kuri uwo musozi, abantu benshi baza gusanganira Yesu.
Umwe muri abo bantu arasemerera ati: “Ndakwinginze untabarire umuhungu wanje, kuko ndamufise ari umwe.
Impwemu mbi imufashe, aca atangura gukoma induru, hanyuma ikamujegeza, agaca abimba ifuro mu kanwa. Iramubabaza cane kandi imurekura asa nk’uwapfuye.
Ninginze abigishwa bawe ngo bayirukane ariko vyabananiye.”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Yemwe bantu b’iki gihe mutizera kandi mwononekaye mu mitima, nzobana namwe gushika ryari ndabihanganira? Zana uwo muhungu wawe hano.”
Bariko baramuzana, ya dayimoni imukubita hasi iramujegeza. Ariko Yesu akankamira iyo mpwemu ihumanye, akiza uwo muhungu, amusubiza se.
Abari ngaho bose batangazwa cane n’ububasha bukomeye bw’Imana.
“Nimunyumvirize neza kandi mushire umutima ku vyo ngira ndababwire: Umwana w’Umuntu agiye gutabwa mu maboko y’abantu.”
Ariko abigishwa bo ntibatahura ico ababwiye. Insiguro y’ayo majambo yari ihishijwe, bituma batayimenya, kandi batinya no kugira ico babimubazako.
Maze haduka impari hagati mu bigishwa bashaka kumenya umukuru muri bo.
Yesu amenye ivyo bariko bariyumvira mu mitima, aca ahamagara umwana mutoya amuhagarika i ruhande yiwe.
Arababarira ati: “Uwakira umwana muto nk’uwu mw’izina ryanje ni jewe aba yakiriye; kandi uwunyakiriye wese aba yakiriye uwantumye. Uwa nyuma muri mwebwe ni we mukuru muri mwese.”
Yohana aramubwira ati: “Mwigisha, twabonye umuntu yirukana abadayimoni mw’izina ryawe, duca turamubuza kuko atari kumwe natwe.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ntimukamubuze, kuko uwutabagwanya aba ari ku ruhande rwanyu.”
Igihe ciwe co kuduzwa mw’ijuru cegereje, Yesu afata ingingo yo kuja i Yerusalemu.
Aca arungika abamwitangira imbere, baja mu mihana y’i Samariya kugira ngo bamutegurire aho azoshikira.
Ariko abantu baho banka kumwakira kuko yari ahaciye aja i Yerusalemu.
Abigishwa biwe Yohana na Yakobo babibonye, babaza Yesu bati: “Mwami, duhamagare umuriro ukoroke uvuye mw’ijuru ubatongore?”
Yesu aca arahindukira, arabakankamira [ati: “Ntimuzi impwemu ibakoresha iyo ari yo! Umwana w’Umuntu ntiyazanywe no guhonya abantu, ahubwo yazanywe no kubakiza.” ]
Nuko baca baja mu yindi mihana.
Bari mu nzira bagenda, umuntu umwe araza abarira Yesu ati: “Nditeguye kugukurikira aho uja hose.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Imbwebwe zirafise imyobo zibamwo n’inyoni zo mu kirere zirafise ivyari, ariko Umwana w’Umuntu ntagira n’aho akika umusaya.”
Yesu aca abarira uwundi muntu ati: “Nkurikira.” Ariko wa muntu aramwishura ati: “Mwami, banza undeke ngende mpambe data.”
Yesu aramubwira ati: “Reka abapfuye mu mpwemu bahambe abapfuye babo, ariko wewe genda uvuge ivy’Ubwami bw’Imana.”
Hanyuma uwundi na we araza avuga ati: “Mwami, ndagukurikira, ariko reka mbanze ngende nsezere umuryango wanje.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Nta muntu araba inyuma ariko ararimisha inka aba abereye Ubwami bw’Imana.”

headings.text: Yesu arungika bamwe cumi na babiri
Petero yatura ko Yesu ari Kristo
Yesu akiza umuhungu aboshwe n’impwemu mbi
Yesu asubira kuvuga ivyerekeye urupfu rwiwe Bagitangajwe n’ivyo yari ahejeje gukora, Yesu abwira abigishwa biwe ati:

verses.text: Ivyo biheze, Umwami Yesu atoranya abandi bigishwa mirongo indwi na babiri, abarungika ari babiribabiri, ngo babe baramwitangira imbere mu bisagara n’ahandi hantu hose yari yimirije kuja.
Arababarira ati: “Ivyimburwa ni vyinshi, ariko abimbuzi ni bake. Nimwinginge nyene ivyimburwa arungike abimbuzi mu vyimburwa vyiwe.
Nimugende! Ndabarungitse nk’intama mu bikoko vy’inkazi.
Ntihagire amahera, isakoshi canke ibirato vyo gukuranya mwitwaza; kandi ntimuramutse abantu mu nzira.
Igihe cose mwinjiye mu nzu y’umuntu, muzobanze muramutse muti: ‘Amahoro abe muri iyi nzu.’
Nimwasanga abo muri iyo nzu ari abanyamahoro, umuhezagiro wanyu uzoba kuri bo. Atari uko na ho, umuhezagiro wanyu uzobagarukako.
Muze mugume muri iyo nzu nyene, murya kandi munywa ivyo babahaye, kuko umukozi wese abereye impembo yiwe. Ntimuze muve mu nzu muja mu yindi.
Nimwinjira mu gisagara bakabakira, muzofungure ivyo muhasanze.
Mukize abagwaye, mwongere mubabwire muti ‘Ubwami bw’Imana burabegereye.’
Ariko nimwinjira mu gisagara ntibabakire, muzoje mu mayira yaho, muvuge muti:
‘N’umukungugu wo mu gisagara canyu uri ku birenge vyacu turawukunkumuye kugira ngo bibabere icagiriji, ariko mumenye neza ko Ubwami bw’Imana bubegereye.’
Ndababwire ukuri, ku musi w’imanza, i Sodomu hazogira agahengekerezo kurusha ico gisagara.

Uzobona ibara, yewe Korazini! Uzobona ibara yewe Betesayida! Kuko iyo ibitangaza vyakorewe iwanyu bikorerwa i Tiro n’i Sidoni, abaho baba barihanye kuva kera, bakambara amagunira, bakisiga n’iminyota.
Ariko ku musi w’imanza, i Tiro n’i Sidoni hazogira agahengekerezo kurusha mwebwe.
Nawe Kaperinawumu, mbega wibaza ko uzoduzwa gushika mw’ijuru? Haba na mba! Ahubwo uzokororerwa i Kuzimu mu kibanza c’abapfuye.
Uwubumvira ni jewe aba yumviye, kandi uwubanka ni jewe aba yanse. Uwunyanse na we aba yanse uwantumye.”
Bamwe mirongo indwi na babiri bagarutse, baza bafise umunezero mwinshi bavuga bati: “Mwami, n’abadayimoni batwumvira mw’izina ryawe.”
Arababwira ati: “Nabonye Satani akoroka nk’umuravyo ava mw’ijuru.
Raba, narabahaye ububasha bwo kunesha ubushobozi bwose bw’umwansi: muzohonyora inzoka na sikoropiyo muzimene imitwe, kandi nta na kimwe kizogira ico kibagira.
Ariko ntimunezerwe n’uko impwemu mbi zibumvira, ahubwo munezerwe n’uko amazina yanyu yanditse mw’ijuru.”

Muri ako kanya, Yesu yuzura umunezero muri Mpwemu Yera, aca avuga ati: “Ndagushima Data, Mwami w’ijuru n’isi, kuko ivyo wabihishije abanyabwenge n’abize, ukabihishurira abameze nk’abana bato. Egome Data, kuko uko ari ko washimye kubikora.
Data yaranyizigiye anzeza vyose. Nta n’umwe azi Umwana atari Data, kandi nta n’umwe azi Data atari Umwana, n’uwo Umwana ahisemwo kumuhishurira.”
Maze arahindukira, abwira abigishwa biwe bonyene ati: “Hahiriwe amaso abona ivyo muriko murabona.
Kuko ndababwira ko abavugishwa n’Imana n’abami benshi bipfuje kubona ivyo muriko murabona ariko ntibabibona, no kwumva ivyo muriko murumva, ariko ntibavyumva.”
Umusi umwe, umwigisha w’ivyagezwe yavuye hasi kugira ngo atege umutego Yesu, aramubaza ati: “Mwigisha, nokora iki kugira ngo ndagwe ubugingo budashira?”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ivyagezwe bivuga iki? Ubitahura gute?”
Aramwishura ati: “ ‘Ukundishe Uhoraho Imana yawe umutima wawe wose, umushaha wawe wose, inkomezi zawe zose n’ubwenge bwawe bwose’; kandi, ‘Ukunde mugenzawe nk’uko wikunda.’”
Yesu aramubwira ati: “Wishuye neza. Genda ubigenze uko, uzobaho ibihe bidashira.”
Ariko wa muntu agomvye kwisigura, aca abaza Yesu ati: “None mugenzanje ni nde?”

Mu kumwishura, Yesu amubwira ati: “Habaye umuntu yariko aramanuka ava i Yerusalemu aja i Yeriko, hanyuma agwa mu maboko y’abambuzi. Bamwambura ivyo yari afise vyose, baramukubita, bamusiga ari hafi gupfa.
Maze akirambaraye aho hantu, haca haza umuherezi yari amanukanye iyo nzira nyene. Amubonye, aca kure yiwe ku rundi ruhande rw’inzira, arirenganira.
Hanyuma haca Umulewi na we nyene aramubona, ariko aca aca kure yiwe ku rundi ruhande rw’inzira, arireganira.
Ariko mu nyuma haza Umusamariya, ashika aho wa muntu arambaraye. Amubonye, amutera ikigongwe.
Aca aramwegera, asomoza ibikomere vyiwe umuvinyu, abisiga amavuta ya elayo, hanyuma abipfukisha igitambara. Aca amushira ku ndogoba yiwe, amutwara mu nzu y’ingenzi, abandanya amwitaho.
Bukeye asokorora idenariyo zibiri azisigarana uwujejwe iyo nzu, amubwira ati: ‘Uwu muntu mumwiteho cane. Ninagaruka nzoriha ayo muzoba mwakoresheje arenga kuri aya.’
None muri abo bose, ni nde yabonetse nk’umugenzi w’uwo muntu yaguye mu bambuzi?”
Wa mwigisha w’ivyagezwe aramwishura ati: “Ni uwo yamugiriye impuhwe.” Yesu aca aramubwira ati: “Genda nawe ukore uko.”
Nuko Yesu n’abigishwa biwe babandanije urugendo, bashika mu mihana, ahaba umugore yitwa Marita, na we abaha ikaze iwe.
Marita yari afise mwene nyina yitwa Mariya. Maze Mariya aragenda yicara imbere y’Umwami Yesu, yumviriza inyigisho ziwe.
Ariko Marita we yari yatwawe n’ibikorwa vyinshi vyo gutegura inzimano. Nuko abaza Yesu ati: “Mwami, mbega nta co bikubwiye kubona mwene mama yantanye ibikorwa? Mubwire aze amfashe.”
Ariko Umwami Yesu aramwishura ati: “Marita, Marita, reka guhagarika umutima, wigora muri vyinshi.
Hari ikintu kimwe gusa ciza kuruta ibindi vyose. Mariya ni co yahisemwo, kandi ntazokwigera acakwa.”

headings.text: Yesu arungika abandi bigishwa mirongo indwi na babiri

verses.text: Umusi umwe Yesu yari ahantu ariko arasenga. Ahejeje, umwe mu bigishwa biwe aramubwira ati: “Mwami, twigishe gusenga nk’uko Yohana yavyigishije abigishwa biwe.”
Arababwira ati: “Mu gusenga mukwiye kuvuga muti: ‘Data, izina ryawe niryubahwe, Ubwami bwawe nibuze.
Uduhe ivyokurya bidukwiye ku musi ku musi.
Uduharire ivyaha vyacu, nk’uko natwe duharira umuntu wese aducumuyeko. Ntudutererane ibitugerageza.’ ”
Yongera ababwira ati: “Dufate ko umwe muri mwebwe afise umugenzi, akaja iwe hagati mw’ijoro, akamubwira ati: ‘Mugenzi, ntabara ungurane imikate itatu.
Umwe mu bagenzi banje arangendeye ubu nyene, kandi singira ico ndamuzimana.’
Maze uwo mugenzi wiwe akamwishura ari mu nzu ati: ‘Nta co ungora, namaze kwugara umuryango kandi twe n’abana banje twamaze kuryama. Sinshobora rero kuvyurwa no kuguha imikate.’
Ndababwire ukuri, naho atovyuka ngo amuhe iyo mikate kubera ari umugenzi wiwe, yovyuka akamuha ivyo akeneye vyose kubera yashishikaye kumugobera ata dusoni.
Ni co gituma nanje ndababwiye nti: ‘Musabe muzohabwa, murondere muzoronka, mudodore muzokwugururirwa.’
Kuko uwusaba wese ahabwa, uwurondera aronka, n’uwudodora yugururirwa.
Ni nde muvyeyi muri mwebwe umwana yosaba ifi akamuha inzoka?
Canke amusavye igi akamuha sikoropiyo?
Nimba mwebwe mushobora guha ingabire nziza abana banyu kandi muri babi mu mitima, mbega So wo mw’ijuru ntazorushiriza guha Mpwemu Yera abamumusavye?”
Umusi umwe Yesu yirukanye umudayimoni yari yateye umuntu kuba ikiragi. Amuvuyemwo, wa muntu aca aravuga, maze abantu baratangara cane.
Ariko bamwe muri bo bavuga bati: “Ni Beyelizebuli, umukuru w’abadayimoni amushoboza kwirukana abadayimoni.”
Abandi na bo bagerageza kugeza Yesu mu kumusaba ikimenyetso kivuye mw’ijuru.
Yesu amenye ivyiyumviro vyabo, aca ababwira ati: “Ubwami bwose bwiciyemwo ibice buba bugiye gusenyuka. Kandi iyo umuryango wiciyemwo ibice uba ugiye gusambuka.
Nimba Satani yigwanije, akicamwo ibice, none ubwami bwiwe bworama gute? Ibi ndabivuze kuko munyagiriza ko nirukana abadayimoni mu bushobozi bwa Beyelizebuli.
None nimba Beyelizebuli ari we anshoboza kwirukana abadayimoni, abigishwa banyu bo babishobozwa na nde? Ni co gituma ari bo bazobatsindisha.
Ariko nimba ububasha bw’Imana ari bwo bunshoboza kwirukana abadayimoni, noneho Ubwami bw’Imana bwashitse muri mwebwe.
Iyo umuntu w’umunyenkomezi kandi afise ibigwanisho bikwiye araririye inzu yiwe, ivyo atunze biba mu mutekano.
Ariko iyo atewe n’uwumurusha inkomezi akamunesha, amwaka ivyo bigwanisho yari yizigiye, akamunyaga n’ivyo atunze, akabihako n’abandi.
Uwutari kumwe nanje wese arangwanya, kandi uwutariko aramfasha kwegeranya wese, aba ariko arasanzaza.
Iyo impwemu ihumanye ivuye mu muntu, ica igenda iyerera mu bugaragwa irondera aho yoruhukira ariko ikahabura. Maze, ica ivuga iti: ‘Reka nisubirire muri ya nzu nahoramwo.’
Ishitse, iraheza igasanga ya nzu isukuye, kandi itunganije neza.
Maze ica igenda ikazana izindi mpwemu mbi indwi ziyirusha ububi, zikinjira muri wa muntu, zikibera ngaho. Ivya nyuma vy’uwo muntu biba bibi kurusha ivya mbere.”
Yesu akiriko aravuga ivyo, umugore yari ngaho avuga n’ijwi rirenga ati: “Hahiriwe umuvyeyi yakuvyaye akakwonsa.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ahubwo hahiriwe abumva ijambo ry’Imana bakarishira mu ngiro.”
Abantu bamaze kumwegera ari benshi, Yesu ababwira ati: “Abantu ba kino gihe ni babi. Basaba ikimenyetso, ariko nta kindi kimenyetso bazohabwa kiretse ica Yona.
Nk’uko Yona yabaye ikimenyetso ku bantu b’i Ninewe, ni ko n’Umwana w’Umuntu azoba ikimenyetso ku bantu ba kino gihe.

Ku musi wo guca imanza, umwamikazi w’i Sheba azohaguruka yagirize abantu ba kino gihe kandi abatsindishe, kuko yahagurutse akava ku mpera z’isi aje kwumviriza amajambo y’ubwenge ya Salomo; ariko raba uwuruta Salomo ari hano.
Ku musi wo guca imanza, abantu b’i Ninewe bazohaguruka bagirize abantu ba kino gihe kandi babatsindishe, kuko bo bihanye bamaze kwumva ubutumwa bwa Yona; ariko raba uwuruta Yona ari hano.
Nta muntu yodomeka itara ngo aheze arihishe canke ngo aryubikeko igiseke. Ariko arishira ku giterekwako itara kugira ngo riboneshereze abinjira mu nzu bose.
Amaso yawe ni yo matara y’umubiri. Iyo amaso yawe abona neza, umubiri wawe wose uba mu muco. Ariko iyo abona nabi, umubiri wawe wose uba mu mwijima.
None rero wiyubare umuco wibaza ko uri muri wewe ntusange ari umwijima.
Vyongeye, umubiri wawe wose niwaba mu muco, ata rugingo na rumwe ruri mu mwijima, uzokayangana nk’aho urasiwe n’umuco w’itara.”
Yesu akiriko aravuga, umwe mu Bafarisayo aramutumira ngo bajane iwe amuzimane. Nuko ashitse, aja ku meza.
Wa Mufarisayo aratangara cane abonye ko Yesu ariye adakaravye.
Maze Umwami Yesu aca amubwira ati: “Mwebwe Abafarisayo mwitwararika cane kwoza igikombe n’isahani inyuma, ariko mwuzuye ubukunzi bw’inda n’ubugizi bwa nabi.
Mwa mburabwenge mwe! Mbega Imana yabumvye imbere si yo yabumvye n’inyuma?
Nuko rero nimuhe aboro ku vyo mufise, maze ibindi vyose kuri mwebwe bizoba bihumanuwe.

Muzobona ibara yemwe Bafarisayo, kuko mutanga ikigiracumi kuri vyose, gushika no ku mboga zo mu matongo yanyu, ariko mukirengagiza guca imanza zibereye, no gukunda Imana. Mwari mukwiye gutanga ico kigiracumi, n’ivyo bindi mutavyirengagije.
Muzobona ibara mwebwe Abafarisayo, kuko mukunda ivyicaro vy’icubahiro mu masinagogi no kuramutswa mu cubahiro mu makoraniro.
Muzobona ibara kuko mumeze nk’imva zitaboneka, abantu bakazicako batabizi.”
Umwe mu bigisha b’ivyagezwe aramubwira ati: “Mwigisha, erega uvuze uko natwe uba udututse!”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Namwe bigisha b’ivyagezwe, muzobona ibara kuko muremereza abantu imitwaro iremereye, kandi ubwanyu mutanayikozako n’urutoke.
Muzobona ibara kuko mwubakira imva z’abavugishwa n’Imana, kandi ari ba sogokuruza banyu babishe.
Muri ivyabona kandi mwemeranya n’ivyo ba sogokuruza banyu bakoze; bo bishe abavugishwa n’Imana, namwe mukabubakira imva.
Ni co gituma Imana mu bwenge bwayo yavuze iti: ‘Nzobarungikira abavugishwa n’intumwa, bamwe muri bo bazobica, abandi babahame.’
None rero, abantu b’iki gihe muzoharurwako amaraso y’abavugishwa n’Imana bose yasheshwe kuva isi ikiremwa,
uhereye ku ya Abeli ugashitsa ku ya Zakariya yiciwe hagati y’igicaniro n’ihema ry’ibonaniro. Ndababwire ukuri, ingaruka z’ayo maraso yose zizoba ku bantu ba kino gihe.
Muzobona ibara yemwe bigisha b’ivyagezwe kuko mwatwaye urupfunguruzo rwo kumenya Imana. Mwebwe ubwanyu ntimwinjiye mu Bwami, ahubwo mwabujije n’abashaka kwinjira.”
Yesu ahejeje kuvuga ivyo, aca ava aho hantu. Abafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe baca batangura kumugwanya cane, bamubaza ibibazo ku bintu bitandukanye,
kugira ngo barabe ko bomufatira ku vyo avuze.

Muri ako kanya nyene, abantu ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bariko baragwirirana, gushika aho ata waronka aho ahonyora. Maze Yesu atangura kubigisha ahereye ku bigishwa biwe, abagabisha ati: “Mwirinde umwambiro w’Abafarisayo, ari bwo buryarya.
Nta cagizwe ibanga kitazomenyekana, kandi nta canyegejwe kitazoshirwa ahabona.
Ivyo mwavugiye ahatabona bizokwumvikanira ahabona, kandi ivyo mwongoreraniye mu vyumba abantu bazobivugira hejuru ku mazu basemerera.
Bagenzi banje, umve ndababwire: ntimugatinye abica umubiri ariko inyuma y’ivyo ata kindi bashobora kubagira.
Ariko ngira ndababwire uwo mukwiye gutinya: mutinye Imana yo ishobora kwica umubiri, ikagira n’ububasha bwo kuwuta mu muriro wa Gehinomu. Ndababwiye ukuri, abe ari yo mutinya.
Mbega utunyoni dutanu ntitugurwa ubusa bw’amahera? Ariko Imana ntiyibagira na kamwe muri two.
Mbere n’imishatsi yo ku mitwe yanyu yaraharuwe yose. Nuko rero ntimutinye, kuko musumvya agaciro utunyoni twinshi.
Ndababwire ukuri, umuntu wese azonyemanga imbere y’abantu, Umwana w’Umuntu na we azomwemanga imbere y’abamarayika b’Imana.
Ariko uwuzonyihakana imbere y’abantu, nanje nzomwihakana imbere y’abamarayika b’Imana.
Kandi umuntu wese atuka Umwana w’Umuntu azobiharirwa, ariko uwutuka Mpwemu Yera ntazobiharirwa.
Nibabashengeza mu masinagogi, imbere y’abatware n’abategetsi, ntimuze muhagarikwe imitima n’ivyo muzokwireguza canke muzovuga.
Mpwemu Yera azobigisha ivyo mukwiye kuvuga ako kanya nyene.”
Umwe mu bari ngaho abwira Yesu ati: “Mwigisha, mbwirira uwo tuvukana yemere tugabure ivyo twarazwe.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Ni nde yangize umucamanza wanyu n’umuhagarikizi wo kubagaburira ivyanyu?”
Aca ababwira ati: “Mube maso, mwirinde guhahamira ivy’isi, kuko ubuzima bw’umuntu ntibuhagaze kw’itunga ryinshi afise.”
Aca abacira umugani ati: “Habaye umugabo w’umutunzi yarimye itongo ryiwe aronka umwimbu mwinshi cane.
Aribwira ati: ‘Mbega nkore iki ko mbuze aho nkwiza umwimbu wanje?’
Aca yigira inama ati: ‘Reka ndabigenze gutya: nsambure ibigega vyanje hanyuma nubake ibibiruta. Gutyo nzoronka aho mbika ingano zanje n’ubundi butunzi.
Hanyuma mpeze mbwire umutima wanje nti: “Mutima wanje, icara uruhuke, urye, unywe, unezerererwe ubuzima, kuko ufise ibizogutunga imyaka myinshi.” ’
Ariko Imana iramubarira iti: ‘Wa gipfu we, iri joro nyene ubuzima bwawe urabwakwa. None ivyo waruhiye bizoba ivya nde?’
Uko ni ko bizogenda kuri abo bose biyegeraniriza ubutunzi bwabo ariko badatunze mu buryo bw’Imana.”
Yesu aca abwira abigishwa biwe ati: “Ni co gituma ndababwira nti: ntimukiganyire kubera ivyo mukeneye kugira ngo mubeho, vyaba ivyokurya canke ivyo kwambara.
Ubuzima buraruta cane ivyokurya, kandi umubiri uraruta cane ivyambarwa.
Nimwitegereze ibikona: ntibibiba kandi ntivyimbura, ntibigira n’ububiko canke ibigega, ariko Imana irabigaburira. None mwebwe ntimuruta inyoni kure n’iyo?
Ni nde muri mwebwe yoshobora kwiyongera akanya na gatoya ko kubaho kubera kwiganyira?
Nimba mutishoboza ikintu gito nk’ico, ni kuki mwiganyira ku bindi?
Nimwitegereze ingene amashurwe yo ku misozi akura. Ntakora kandi ntajisha impuzu. Ariko ndababwira ko na Salomo ubwiwe mu cubahiro ciwe cose atigeze ashaza nka rimwe muri yo.
Nimba Imana yambika gutyo ivyatsi vyo ku misozi, biriho uno musi ariko ejo bikazotererwa mu ziko, mbega ntizorushirizaho kubambika, yemwe ab’ukwizera guke?
Kandi ntimugashire umutima ku vyo muzorya canke muzonywa; ntimukiganyire kuri ivyo.
Kuko n’abantu bo mu mahanga yose yo kw’isi na bo ivyo ni vyo birukira ubudasiba, ariko mweho So wo mw’ijuru arazi ko ivyo vyose mubikeneye.
Ahubwo nimubanze mwitwararike Ubwami bw’Imana, ivyo na vyo izobibaha nk’inyongera.
Yewe busho buto, ntutinye kuko So wo mw’ijuru bimuhimbara kuguha Ubwami.
Nimugurishe ivyo mutunze, mubihe aboro. Mwironderere imifuko ibika amahera itazoshira, n’ubutunzi budahera bwo mw’ijuru, aho abasuma badashika, n’imiswa itazobwonona.
Kuko aho ubutunzi bwanyu buri ari ho imitima yanyu izoba.
Mwame mukenyeye kandi amatara yanyu yame yaka,
mumere nk’abanyarugo barindiriye ko shebuja ava mu bukwe kugira ngo bace bamwugururira niyashika akadodora.
Hahiriwe abo bakozi shebuja azosanga bagiteramye bamurindiriye. Ndababwije ukuri ko na we azokenyera akabicarika, hanyuma akabagaburira.
Hahiriwe abo bakozi shebuja azosanga bagiteramye bamurindiriye, naho yoza mu gicugu canke bugiye guca.
Mutahure ibi: iyaba nyene inzu yomenye isaha igisuma kizirako, ntiyokwemera ko kimena inzu yiwe.
Namwe mukwiye kwama mugavye, kuko Umwana w’Umuntu azoza mu gihe mutamwiteze.”
Petero aramubaza ati: “Mwami, uwu mugani uwuciriye twebwe gusa, canke uwuciriye bose?”
Umwami Yesu aramwishura ati: “Mbega umunyabigega w’umwizigirwa kandi w’umunyabwenge ni nde? Ni uwo shebuja ashobora guha ubukuru bwo kuganza abandi bakozi no kubagaburira mu gihe gikwiye.
Azoba ahiriwe uwo mukozi shebuja azosanga akora gutyo niyagaruka.
Ndababwire ukuri, azoshika amuzeza ivyo atunze vyose.
Ariko vyogenda gute hamwe uwo mukozi yokwibwira mu mutima ati: ‘Databuja yatevye kugaruka,’ hanyuma agatangura gukubita abandi bakozi, akirira, akinywera, akiborererwa?
Shebuja azoshika umusi uwo mukozi atari yiteze ko ashikirako, no kw’isaha atazi. Azomuhimbagura hanyuma amusangize ikibanza n’abatizera.
Uwo mukozi yari asanzwe azi ivyo shebuja agomba hanyuma ntavyitegurire ngo abikore, azohanwa bikomeye.
Ariko uwutazi ivyo shebuja agomba, hanyuma agakora ibitari vyo, azohanwa buhoro. Uwahawe vyinshi azosabwa vyinshi, kandi uwajwe vyinshi azobazwa vyinshi.
Naje kwatsa umuriro kw’isi; ese iyo uba umaze kwaka!
Hariho umubatizo w’imibabaro ntegerezwa kubatizwa, kandi urandemereye mu mutima kugeza ndawubatijwe.
Mbega mwiyumvira ko naje ngo nzane amahoro kw’isi? Haba na mba! Ahubwo naje gutuma abantu bacanamwo.
Uhereye ubu, mu muryango w’abantu batanu bazocanamwo, batatu bagwanye babiri, babiri bagwanye batatu.
Umugabo azogwanya umuhungu wiwe, umuhungu na we agwanye se; umugore azogwanya umukobwa wiwe, umukobwa na we agwanye nyina; umugore azogwanya umukazana wiwe, umukazana na we agwanye inabukwe.”
Yongera abwira isinzi ry’abantu bari aho ati: “Iyo mubonye igicu kivuye mu burengero, muca muvuga muti: ‘Imvura igira igwe,’ kandi biba uko nyene.
Mubonye umuyaga uhuhuse uva mu bumanuko, mukavuga muti: ‘Hagira haze ubushuhe,’ kandi bica biba uko nyene.
Mwa ndyarya mwe, ko mushobora gutahura ibimenyetso vy’ibihe murabiye ku biba kw’isi no kw’ijuru, ni igiki kibabuza gutahura ivy’iki gihe?
Ni kuki mudashobora guca urubanza, mugahitamwo ikibereye?

Nihagira umuntu aja kukwitwarira ku mucamanza, wihutire kwiyuzuza na we mutarashikayo. Ahandi ho, azogushikana imbere y’umucamanza, hanyuma na we agutange ku mukuru w’ibohero, maze na we agute mw’ibohero.
Ndakubwire ukuri, ntuzovayo utarishe n’igiceri ca nyuma umuheraniye.”

headings.text: Yesu agabisha abantu yongera abatera intege
Yesu avuga ko abantu bazocanamwo ku bwiwe

verses.text: Bamwe mu bari ngaho baca babwira Yesu inkuru y’abantu b’i Galilaya Pilato yishe akavanga amaraso yabo n’ay’ibimazi bariko baratanga.
Yesu arababwira ati: “Mbega mwibaza ko abo bantu b’i Galilaya bababajwe gutyo kubera bari abanyavyaha kurusha abandi Banyagalilaya?
Haba na mba! Ariko nimutihana namwe muzohona nka bo.
Canke mwibaza ko bamwe cumi n’umunani bapfa igihe umunara wabagwako i Silowamu bari abanyavyaha kurusha abandi bantu bose baba i Yerusalemu?
Haba na mba! Ariko nimutihana namwe muzohona nka bo.”
Aca abacira uwu mugani ati: “Umuntu umwe yari afise igiti c’umusukoni giteye mu murima wiwe w’imizabibu. Umusi umwe aja kuraba ko hari icamwa yosangako, arabura.
Aca abarira umukozi yari ajejwe uwo murima ati: ‘Maze imyaka itatu nza kurondera ivyamwa kuri uwu musukoni, ariko singire ico ndonka. Giteme, kuko nta cotuma kibandanya conona isi.’
Wa mukozi aramubarira ati: ‘Databuja, cihanganire uwundi mwaka, ndakibagarire nongere ndagitabire.
Nicama bizoba ari vyiza, nikitama na ho uzoheza ugiteme.’ ”
Umusi umwe Yesu yariko arigisha mw’isinagogi kandi hari kw’Isabato.
Aho hari umugore yari amaze imyaka cumi n’umunani amugajwe n’impwemu mbi. Yari yarahetamye umugongo, ntiyashobora kugororoka.
Yesu amubonye aca aramuhamagara ngo aze aho ari, amubwira ati: “Mupfasoni, ndakubohoye ubumuga bwawe.”
Aca amurambikako ibiganza. Ako kanya nyene, aca aragororoka, ahimbaza Imana.

Ariko umukuru w’isinagogi ababazwa n’uko Yesu akijije umuntu ku musi w’Isabato. Aca abarira abantu bari aho ati: “Imisi y’ibikorwa ni itandatu. Muzohore muza gukizwa ingwara muri iyo misi, ariko atari ku musi w’Isabato.”
Umwami Yesu aca arishura ati: “Mwa ndyarya mwe! Ni nde muri mwebwe atozitura inka canke indogoba yiwe mu ruhongore ku musi w’Isabato ngo ayijane kunywa amazi?
Mbega uwu mugore akaba n’umukobwa wa Aburahamu yari amaze imyaka cumi n’umunani aboshwe na Satani, ntiyari akwiye kubohorwa, naho ari ku musi w’Isabato?”
Avuze ivyo, abamugwanya bose baramaramara. Ariko abandi bose bari banezerejwe cane n’ibitangaza yariko arakora.
Nuko Yesu abandanya avuga ati: “Mbega Ubwami bw’Imana bumeze nk’iki? Nobugereranya n’iki?
Bumeze nk’akabuto k’igiterwa citwa mutaride umuntu yateye mu murima wiwe, karakura gahinduka igiti, maze inyoni zo mu kirere ziraza zarika mu mashami yaco.”
Yongerako ati: “Ubwami bw’Imana nobugereranya n’iki?
Bugereranywa n’umwambiro umugore akoresha mu gukora imikate. Naho yokoresha umwambiro muke mw’ifu ingana n’ingero zitatu, uwo mwambiro muke utuma igikandu cose c’umukate gikakama.”
Nuko Yesu aca mu bisagara no mu mihana yigisha, yerekeye i Yerusalemu.
Umuntu umwe aramubaza ati: “Mwami, ubwo abakizwa ntibazoba bake?” Yesu aramwishura ati:
“Mugire umwete wo guca mw’irembo ryaga, kuko ndababwire ukuri, benshi bazogerageza kwinjira ariko ntibabishobore.
Nyene inzu niyahaguruka akugara umuryango, muzohagarara inyuma mudodora, mutakamba muti: ‘Nyakwubahwa, twugururire.’ Na we azobishura ati: ‘Sindabazi kandi sinzi n’iyo muva.’
Namwe muzovuga muti: ‘Twarira kandi twanywera imbere yawe, mbere wigishiriza mu mabarabara y’iwacu.’
Ariko azobishura ati: ‘Sindabazi kandi sinzi n’iyo muva. Mviraho mwa nkozi z’ibibi mwe!’
Ni ho hazoba amarira no guhekenya amenyo, nimwabona Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo hamwe n’abavugishwa bose mu Bwami bw’Imana, namwe muterewe hanze.
Abantu bazova mu buseruko no mu burengero, mu buraruko no mu bumanuko, bahabwe ivyicaro mu mazimano yo mu Bwami bw’Imana.
Kandi mumenye ko hari bamwe mu bari inyuma bazoba ab’imbere, na bamwe mu bari imbere bazoba ab’inyuma.”
Ico gihe, bamwe mu Bafarisayo baca baza aho Yesu ari, bamubwira bati: “Va ngaha ugende, kuko Herode Antipa agomba kukwica.”
Yesu arabishura ati: “Genda mubwire iyo mbwebwe ko ndiko ndirukana abadayimoni nongera nkiza abagwaye uno musi n’ejo; ku musi ugira gatatu nzoba ndangije igikorwa canje.
Uko biri kwose, ntegerezwa kubandanya urugendo rwanje uno musi n’ejo na hirya y’ejo, kuko nta handi umuvugishwa akwiye kwicirwa atari i Yerusalemu.

Yewe Yerusalemu, yewe Yerusalemu! Wewe wica abavugishwa n’Imana, ugatera amabuye abagutumweko. Ni kangahe nagerageje kwegeranya abana bawe nk’uko inkoko yegeraniriza imiswi yayo mu mababa yayo, ariko ukanyankira!
Kubw’ivyo, raba inzu yanyu igiye kuba akahebwe. Ndababwira ukuri ko mutazosubira kumbona kugeza aho muzovugira muti: ‘Hahezagirwe uwuje mw’izina ry’Uhoraho.’ ”
Umusi umwe, hari kw’Isabato, Yesu aja kuzimanwa mu nzu y’umwe mu bakuru b’Abafarisayo, kandi abari ngaho bose bari bamushinze ijisho.
Imbere yiwe hari umugabo agwaye ingwara yo kuvyimba umubiri.
Yesu abaza Abafarisayo n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe ati: “Mbega biremewe gukiza umuntu ku musi w’Isabato?”
Ariko ntibagira ico bamwishura. Maze Yesu aca amukorako, aramukiza, aramurungika arigira.
Aca ababaza ati: “Ni nde muri mwebwe yoba afise umwana canke inka, uwo mwana aguye mu kinogo ntamukureyo; canke iyo nka iguye mu kinogo ntayikureyo, ngo ni uko ari ku musi w’Isabato?”
Na ho nyene ntibashobora kuronka ico bamwishura.
Yesu abonye ukuntu abatumire bahitamwo ivyicaro vy’imbere, aca abaha impanuro ati:
“Nibagutumira mu musi mukuru w’ubukwe, ntuze uhitemwo icicaro c’imbere, kuko bishoboka ko hari uwugusumvya icubahiro nawe yatumiwe nkawe.
Muri ico gihe, nyene urubanza azoza akubwire ati: ‘Mubise yicare.’ Maze uzogenda uramaramara kwicara mu kibanza c’inyuma ya bose.
Ariko nibagutumira, uze uhitemwo icicaro c’inyuma kugira ngo nyene urubanza abe ari we aza akubwire ati: ‘Mugenzi, kaze mu cicaro c’imbere.’ Ico gihe uzoba utewe iteka imbere y’abandi batumire bose.
Kuko uwishira hejuru wese azocishwa bugufi, ariko uwicisha bugufi azoshirwa hejuru.”
Yesu aca abarira uwamutumiye ati: “Niwategura umusi mukuru, ntuze utumire abagenzi, abavukanyi, incuti, canke ababanyi batunze. Kuko na bo bazogutumira, maze impera yawe ibe iyo.
Ahubwo niwategura umusi mukuru, uze utumire abakene, abamugaye, abacumbagira n’abatabona.
Aho ni ho uzohezagirwa. Kubera yuko badashobora kubikwishura, Imana izobiguhembera mw’izuka ry’abagororotsi.”
Umwe mu bari ngaho ahejeje kwumva ayo majambo, aca abarira Yesu ati: “Hahiriwe uwuzofungura ku mazimano yo mu Bwami bw’Imana.”
Yesu aramwishura ati: “Habaye umuntu yateguye umusi mukuru, atumira abantu benshi.
Igihe co kuzimana kigeze, atuma umukozi wiwe kubwira abatumire ati: ‘Nimuze, vyose vyatunganye.’
Ariko bose baca batangura kwerekana ibibafatiriye bituma batagenda. Uwa mbere ati: ‘Unyihanganire, mpejeje kugura itongo, ngira nje kuriraba.’
Uwundi na we ati: ‘Ndakwingize umbabarire, naguze inka cumi zirima, ngiye gusuzuma ko zikora neza.’
Uwundi na we ati: ‘Sinshobora kuza kuko narongoye.’

Wa mukozi aragaruka abwira shebuja ingene vyagenze. Maze na we arashavura cane, aca amubwira ati: ‘Genda mu mabarabara no mu mayira yo mu gisagara, uzane abakene, abacumbagira, abatabona, hamwe n’abamugaye.’
Ahejeje kubikora, wa mukozi abwira shebuja ati: ‘Databuja, ivyo wantumye nabikoze, ariko haracasigaye ibibanza bigaragara.’
Shebuja aramubarira ati: ‘Genda mu mayira y’inyuma y’igisagara no mu mirombero, winginge abantu ushimitse, baze kugira ngo inzu yanje yuzure.
Ndababwire ukuri, nta n’umwe mu bo nari natumiye ubwa mbere aja no kwumviriza ku mazimano yanje.’ ”
Yesu ari mu nzira agenda, hari isinzi ry’abantu bari bamukurikiye. Maze Yesu, arahindukira ababwira ati:
“Uwugomba kunkurikira ariko ntiyanke se, canke nyina, canke umugore wiwe, canke abana biwe, canke abo bavukana, ndetse n’ubuzima bwiwe na bwo nyene, ntashobora kuba umwigishwa wanje.
